title: Online Fitness Coach
description:
About The Role:

Fitribe is looking for a passionate, energetic, and client-focused Online Female Fitness Coach to join our growing coaching team full-time.This role is ideal for someone who genuinely loves helping women improve their health, confidence, and lifestyle through sustainable fitness and nutrition habits. You'll work closely with clients to provide accountability, support, education, and guidance throughout their journey. Fluent and Perfect English is required



Our coaching philosophy is built around consistency, community, and long-term results rather than quick fixes, so we're looking for a coach who shares those values.



While experience in nutrition, exercise science, physical therapy, or other health-related fields is highly valued, what matters most is your ability to connect with clients, deliver exceptional coaching, and help people achieve lasting results.



Key Responsibilities

- Voiced and Messaging Client Coaching & Support

- Deliver a high level of coaching support through Trainerize and other communication platforms.

- Build strong relationships with clients through regular communication and accountability.

- Provide personalised feedback, encouragement, and guidance to help clients stay engaged and motivated.

- Monitor client progress and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.

- Support clients through challenges, barriers, and setbacks while maintaining a positive coaching experience.



Program Management:

- Design and adjust personalised training programs based on client goals, experience level, injuries, and lifestyle factors.

- Review client data including workouts, nutrition logs, progress photos, measurements, and check-ins.

- Make program adjustments as needed to ensure continued progress and adherence.



Client Experience:

- Maintain timely responses to client messages and support requests.

- Conduct regular check-ins and follow-up communication.

- Deliver a supportive, professional, and empathetic coaching experience.

- Contribute to client retention through proactive engagement and relationship building.



Team Collaboration:

- Work closely with the coaching and operations teams.

- Participate in team meetings and performance reviews.

- Contribute ideas to improve systems, processes, and client outcomes.



Essential Requirements:

- Female fitness coach or personal trainer.

- Previous experience coaching clients online or in person.

- Strong understanding of strength training, fat loss, habit formation, and client accountability.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Highly organised with strong time management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple clients while maintaining a high level of service.

- Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment.

- Positive attitude with a genuine passion for helping others succeed.

- Preferred Experience



While not required, the following experience will be highly regarded:

Trainerize experience.

Nutrition coaching experience.

Experience coaching women in perimenopause and menopause.

Exercise Science qualification.

Personal Training certification.

Strength and Conditioning qualification.

Physical Therapy, Allied Health, or Rehabilitation background.

Experience working within an online coaching business.

What We're Looking For



The ideal coach is:

Empathetic and approachable.

Professional and reliable.

Proactive rather than reactive.

Comfortable building relationships through online communication.

Passionate about creating long-term lifestyle change.

Committed to providing an outstanding client experience.



**SUPER IMPORTANT REMINDERS BELOW**

To be considered for this role, please submit:

1. Resume/CV

Your most up-to-date resume outlining your experience and qualifications.

2. Introduction Video (3–5 Minutes)

Tell us a little about yourself, your coaching experience, and why you'd be a great fit for Fitribe.



Please include links to both your resume and introduction video with your application. Applications with both requirements will be prioritised for review.

title: Press & Outreach Manager for a Nationally-Touring Comedy Show
description:
ABOUT THE SHOW



I produce and host a nationally-touring comedy/dating show called Love Isn't Blind - the gimmick is that the men can't speak! Four men compete for one bachelorette. We have real success stories, including two marriages.



We've been featured on NBC's California Live, The Tamron Hall Show, and more. I currently tour Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego, Portland, Seattle, New York, and Washington DC.



THE ROLE



I need someone to take over press, marketing, and outreach entirely. Right now I do all of it myself, on top of producing and hosting the actual show, and I simply don't have the time anymore. I'm drowning!



To be clear: this is NOT a social media manager role. I'm not looking for content calendars or follower growth. *This is a pitching job.*



Here's what you'd own:



PRESS - Local city press, alt-weeklies, newsletters, event calendars, culture reporters, national trend reporters. Finding the right person at each outlet, verifying their actual beat, and writing a pitch that fits what they publish. I do NOT want my pitches to feel or sound like spam.



PODCASTS - Dating, comedy, culture, and sometimes entrepreneurial. Vetting a show's recent episodes before claiming a fit, then pitching me and the show as a guest.



COMMUNITY & GROUP OUTREACH - Rec sports leagues, run clubs, alumni clubs, young professionals groups. A discount code in exchange for sharing the show with their members.



CREATOR OUTREACH - Pitching relevant influencers to cover the show.



EVENT CALENDARS - Submissions for every show, in every city.



WHAT MATTERS MOST:



RESEARCH THAT HOLDS UP. This is the big one. Verify on an org's own live site or social profile before pitching them. If you can't confirm something, please just say so! I would much rather hear "I couldn't confirm this" than get a confident pitch built on a dead link.



WRITING. Short, punchy, sometimes funny pitches, all day long. Your written English needs to pass as native in an
 to an American reporter. This one is a hard requirement.



FLUENCY WITH CLAUDE. I run my entire outreach operation through it, and I want someone who can do it better than I can - and who double-checks every factual claim it produces. If your instinct is to paste AI output straight into an
, this isn't the job. 



JUDGMENT. Knowing who NOT to pitch is half the job.



ORGANIZATION. You'll be pitching seven cities at once, and hopefully more in 2027.



REQUIREMENTS:



- 2+ years in pitching, PR, publicity, marketing, or partnerships, where you had to persuade a stranger over

- At home in Gmail, Google Sheets, Drive, and Instagram DMs

- I do NOT want someone to have to work all night for this job. That said, it would be great to hire an early bird who is okay to start between 7-8 am local time, because that means we can at least overlap working hours from about 4-7 pm my time daily. Press does require fast responses when we receive interest. I will also want to be cc'ed on every
 so that if something time sensitive comes in while you're asleep, I can get to it!



STRONGLY PREFERRED:



- Experience pitching entertainment: live events, comedy, theater, film, festivals, touring acts, talent - in the U.S., Europe, or Canada.

- Canva-level graphic design for cover photos and event graphics

- Familiarity with Eventbrite

- You like comedy and have opinions about it



WHERE THIS GOES:



I'd love this to grow into owning the strategy: which cities are underperforming, which channels actually convert, moving from discount codes to affiliate links and real data, and building templates and AI workflows.



COMP:



Please let me know your rate. This is a full time position, but I would like to do a paid trial first.



TO APPLY



 a resume and a short cover letter to 
 love to know:



- What hours you could work in PST?

- The most relevant pitching you've done and an example pitch.

- How you use AI in your work, and one example of something you got it to do well.



Thank you!

title: Social Media Manager & Strategist - Instagram, TikTok, Facebook (US Real Estate Brand)
description:
$10/hour | 15 hours a week | flat $650/month retainer, no time tracking | long-term



THE ROLE



I'm a real estate team lead in Pittsburgh, PA. Top 1% nationally, $115M+ sold, 119 families helped last year.



My YouTube channel has over a million views. My Instagram has 597 posts and 752 followers.



That gap is the job. My video content works when someone puts real effort into it, and social has never gotten that effort. There's no plan behind any of it. No formats, no strategy, nobody thinking about what's worth making. I post so the account isn't empty.



I'm changing that. One person owns Instagram,
, and TikTok completely. You build the plan, you tell me what to film, I film it, you turn it into something worth watching. I'm the talent. You're the director.



WHAT YOU'D BE WORKING WITH



I'm not short on material. 425 homes sold across Western PA, 119 families last year, listings at every price point all around Pittsburgh, and a team with their own closings.



You also won't be dragging content out of me. I've been on camera for years and I'll shoot what you ask for. Tell me the schedule that fits the formats you pick, whether that's batch days, on-site during listings, or something else, and I'll build my calendar around it.



What's missing is someone who knows which parts are worth telling and how to tell them.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- The plan. Recurring formats my audience recognizes, not random posts.

- The shot list and the filming rhythm. Tell me what to film, what to say, and when. You design the schedule, I'll hold it.

- Editing. My raw footage into short-form that holds attention.

- Posting and platform management. Cadence, captions, keyword and SEO, cover frames, stories, comment replies.

- Platform-specific treatment. I don't want the same file posted three times. Each platform gets what it rewards, and keeping current on that is your job.

- Team requests. My agents have a steady stream of Just Listed and Sold properties. Build a template early so these are a photo swap, not a design project. Important, but never ahead of the strategic work.

- A profile overhaul in your first month: bio, highlights, pinned posts.



THE STANDARD



Five feed posts a week, three of them video, two cut from footage we shoot for the purpose. Stories running consistently. Comments answered inside 24 hours.



That's the floor, not the goal. Those 597 posts prove volume alone does nothing. If a post isn't good enough for your own portfolio, don't publish it.



Fifteen hours is tight for that list and I know it. If something has to give, it's volume, never quality.



To be clear about how the money works: this is a flat monthly retainer, not hourly billing, so a heavy week doesn't become a bigger invoice. But if we get a few months in and we both agree the work has outgrown 15 hours, we'll talk about moving to 20 and the pay moves with it. I'm not looking to squeeze 20 hours of work out of a 15 hour contract.



First 30 days are different. Build the templates, dial in the formats, and get it right. If your full 15 hours goes into two excellent videos and a system we can repeat, that's a win.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

This is a social media manager job first. You'll edit and design as part of it, and you need to be genuinely good at both, but I'm hiring you for judgment about what to make and why. If your pitch is turnaround time and effects, this isn't the role.



- You've grown a US-based personal brand or business account and can show me the numbers.

- You think in formats and hooks, not posts. You'll tell me what to make, not ask me what I want.

- You have opinions and you share them. I expect options and a recommendation, not a question back to me. If my idea is boring, say so.

- Strong design eye. Premium, modern, current. No cheap-looking templates.

- You edit your own short-form and it's good. Tight cuts, clean captions, no dead air.

- No AI slop. I can tell when a caption was written by ChatGPT, and so can everyone else. The writing has to sound like me.

- Reliable internet, backup power, and a machine that edits video without stuttering.

- One 30-minute call per week at 8:00 AM Eastern, which is your evening.



THE DETAILS



$650 per month, paid as a flat retainer twice monthly via Wise, transfer fees covered. Prorated 13th month bonus every December. No time tracking, no screenshots. Other clients are fine by me. You bring your own editing software. I provide Canva Pro, a company
, Google Drive with room for heavy video, Meta Business Suite access, and a commercial music license.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph only. Contact outside the platform will be ignored.



1) Start your message with SCROLLSTOP

2) Show me an account you've run. Yours or a client's, current or past, with real numbers. Then link your portfolio.

/tarasah. In 3 or 4 sentences, what do you think an agent like me should be known for, and why?

description:

ABOUT THE ROLE



The Billing Support Specialist supports billing operations, customer billing enquiries, revenue recovery, disputes, and related administration. The role ensures accurate and timely billing, investigates discrepancies, follows up outstanding balances, and escalates complex or high-risk matters to the Accounting Operations Manager.



The role works closely with the Australian Billing team, Customer Service, internal teams, customers, and courier partners to resolve billing matters efficiently.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Billing & Customer Support



Review billing data, rates, surcharges, and identify discrepancies.

Investigate and resolve routine billing issues and customer enquiries.

Assist with invoices, adjustments, disputes, and carrier queries.

Maintain accurate billing and account records.



Revenue Recovery



Monitor and follow up overdue invoices and outstanding balances.

Contact customers regarding payments and approved payment arrangements.

Assist with aged debt and revenue recovery reporting.

Escalate high-value or problematic debts.



Disputes & Revenue Protection



Investigate and follow up billing and carrier disputes.

Monitor potential fraud, mis-declared shipments, and revenue leakage.

Escalate complex, sensitive, or high-risk matters.



Reporting & Team Support



Prepare billing, debt, and revenue reports.

Support Customer Service, Sales, and Accounting Operations.

Identify recurring issues and assist with process improvements.

Support the transition of routine billing activities to the BPO team.

Follow company procedures and escalation guidelines.



REQUIREMENTS

Minimum 2 years’ experience in billing, accounts receivable, collections, revenue recovery, or customer service.

Strong attention to detail, analytical and problem-solving skills.

Good computer literacy and ability to manage multiple priorities.

Strong communication, customer service, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Good judgement and ability to identify when escalation is required.

Professional, proactive, and adaptable approach.

Ability to maintain confidentiality, accuracy, and data integrity.



Work Setup: Remote, 1 week onsite training (Pasig City)

Work Schedule: Day Shift

title: Business Loan Closer — Warm Leads — Day Shift — ₱200K+/mo OTE
description:
THE MONEY



- Our agents currently average AUD $1,200/week — approx. ₱200,000+/month at current exchange rates. Paid in AUD.

- Base salary — paid weekly

- Uncapped commissions — paid weekly as your deals settle

- Earn up to A$800 commission on a single large deal

- Repeat clients are YOUR deals: when a client you funded comes back for more, you fund them again — and repeat deals can pay the highest commissions in our plan

- Monthly performance bonuses on top

- Weekly 1-on-1 sales coaching and development from day one

- After a 2-month probation: base salary increase, health insurance (HMO) allowance, paid annual and sick leave, and higher bonus tiers





WHO WE ARE



Ezy Pzy Finance (
) is an ABN-registered Australian business finance company. We connect Australian business owners with a panel of major non-bank lenders — and we’re growing fast. We need an experienced closer to join our remote team ASAP.





THE ROLE — BUSINESS LOAN CONSULTANT



- Call warm, pre-generated leads — Australian business owners who have already shown interest in funding. No cold calling. No lead generation. No scraping lists.

- Qualify them, guide them through the loan process, handle objections, negotiate, and close — all the way to settlement.

- Full training on our products, lenders, and sales process is provided.

- Clear progression: your first 4 weeks are structured training and ramp-up on smaller loan facilities (up to ~$30K). You graduate to larger deals as you hit clear quality and settlement milestones.





HOURS — DAY SHIFT



- 45 hours/week, Monday–Friday, 6:30am–4:30pm PH time (1-hour lunch)

- Australian business hours = no graveyard shift. Finished by late afternoon, evenings free with your family.

- Fully remote.





WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You’re a proven closer. Ideally you’ve worked in one of these:

- US merchant cash advance (MCA) / business lending campaigns

- Australian or US mortgage, asset finance, or business loan campaigns

- Debt solutions, insurance, or other financial products sales

- Loan/finance experience is strongly preferred — but we’ll consider exceptional closers from other industries who can show hard numbers.



Non-negotiables:

- 2+ years outbound sales experience with demonstrable results (targets hit, revenue closed — bring numbers)

- C1/C2 English — fluent, neutral accent

- Hungry, self-motivated, organized — you manage your own pipeline and follow-ups relentlessly

- Reliable internet plus backup power/internet solution

- Available 45 hrs/week on the schedule above





HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY



Incomplete applications will not be considered. Complete applications get a response within 48 hours.



Provide ALL 5 of the following:

- A short video (3–5 minutes, Loom / Google Drive / unlisted YouTube link) in two parts: Part 1 — introduce yourself, your sales experience, and the results/KPIs you achieved (numbers, not adjectives). Part 2 — a 2-minute mock opening of a discovery call: pretend you’ve just dialled an Australian business owner from Ezy Pzy Finance — do your opening, build rapport, and start qualifying them for funding.

- Link to your resume.

- Screenshots of your DISC assessment and IQ test results (tests available at 
/testcontent).

- Screenshot of your internet speed test, provider, and PC/laptop specs.

- Your backup internet and power solutions.

- Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a Zoom interview, including a live discovery-call role-play.



If you’re a closer who wants warm leads, weekly commissions, and Australian day-shift hours — apply now.

title: Full-Time WFH Account Manager (Client Retention) — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Paid Ads Specialist
description:
PAID ADS SPECIALIST VA — GOOGLE & META ADS



I am looking for an experienced Paid Ads Specialist to help me improve the Google and Meta advertising for my growing voice and artist-development academy in the United States.



This will begin as a paid, project-based role, with the possibility of ongoing part-time work if we work well together and the campaigns produce qualified leads.



ABOUT MY BUSINESS



I own Melodies Voice Academy, a contemporary voice and artist-development studio near Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. I serve children, teens, and adults through private voice lessons, songwriting, musicianship, performance opportunities, and artist-development programs.



I am currently a small, owner-led business preparing to open an expanded storefront. I need someone who can bring specialized advertising knowledge to my team, communicate clearly, and help me create a system I can understand and maintain.



My goal is to attract qualified local students—not simply generate clicks, impressions, or engagement.



THE CURRENT PROBLEM



My Wix-managed Google campaign spent approximately $57 and generated 385 clicks, but all of those clicks came from Google Display. Google Search generated no clicks, and the campaign produced no inquiries.



My Meta advertising setup also needs to be reviewed carefully because assets for two different businesses may currently be connected. Nothing may be deleted, transferred, merged, or disconnected without my approval.



INITIAL RESPONSIBILITIES



You will:



* Audit my current Google Ads, Meta Ads, Wix, and conversion-tracking setup.

* Explain your findings to me before making major changes.

* Create a Google Search-only campaign focused on high-intent local prospects.

* Prevent the campaign from spending on Google Display, YouTube, Gmail, Discover, and irrelevant traffic.

* Research high-intent keywords and appropriate match types.

* Create and maintain a negative-keyword list.

* Use tight geographic targeting around my studio north of Pittsburgh.

* Separate campaigns or ad groups for parents of young singers and adult singers.

* Send each audience to the correct existing landing page.

* Configure and test Wix inquiry-form submissions as Google Ads conversions.

* Review my Meta Business setup and document which assets belong to each business.

* Set up a simple Meta lead campaign using creative and copy I approve.

* Record a screen-share walkthrough of the completed setup.

* Provide simple written instructions that I or another VA can use to monitor results.



HOW I DEFINE SUCCESS



I am not looking for inexpensive clicks, large reach, or impressive-looking reports.



The results that matter to me are:



* Qualified local inquiries

* Booked introductory voice assessments

* Cost per qualified lead

* Cost per booked assessment

* Enrolled students



REQUIRED SKILLS



You must have hands-on experience with:



* Google Search campaigns

* Meta lead-generation campaigns

* Google Ads conversion tracking

* Wix forms or similar website form tracking

* Local-service lead generation

* Keyword match types

* Negative keywords

* Geographic targeting

* Meta Business Portfolio permissions and assets

* Clear written and spoken English



Experience with music schools, performing-arts programs, education, children’s activities, or appointment-based local businesses is helpful but not required.



COMPENSATION



Initial paid project: $250–$400 USD, depending on your experience and proposed scope.



I expect to divide the project into two stages:



1. Paid audit and written recommendations

2. Approved campaign setup and tracking implementation



Successful completion may lead to ongoing part-time optimization work at approximately $75–$150 USD per month.



ACCOUNT SECURITY AND WORKING EXPECTATIONS



* I will provide proper collaborator or user access. I will not share personal passwords.

* All accounts and advertising assets must remain owned by Melodies Voice Academy.

* Do not create business assets under your personal ownership.

* Do not launch campaigns, increase budgets, delete assets, or make structural account changes without my approval.

* Tell me clearly about any risks before making changes.

* Document your work so I can understand what was done and maintain the system.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words “SEARCH INTENT.” Applications without these words will not be considered.



Please answer the following questions:



1. Why did my campaign receive 385 Google Display clicks but no Google Search clicks?

2. What would you investigate or change first?

3. How would you ensure that a campaign runs on Google Search only?

4. How would you track a Wix inquiry-form submission as a Google Ads conversion?

5. How would you advertise differently to parents of young singers and adult singers?

6. List at least eight negative keywords you would consider for a local voice-lesson campaign.

7. How would you safely review Meta assets connected to two businesses without risking either business?

8. Describe one local-service campaign you personally managed. What was the budget, cost per qualified lead, and final business result?

9. What would you charge for this project?

10. How many hours would you expect the initial audit and setup to require?



Please include screenshots or anonymized examples of campaigns you personally managed. Generic certificates, copied answers, and agency presentations are not sufficient.



I value honesty, careful thinking, reliability, clear communication, documentation, and measurable results. I am looking for someone who can become a trusted specialist and help me make good advertising decisions—not someone who promises unrealistic results.

title: Operations Manager
description:
About Reputation Brands



Reputation Brands is a holding company that buys and operates the businesses that measure, defend, and repair what the internet says about a company.



People used to look things up. Now they are told. Search engines returned options and let the reader d
. AI systems synthesize everything published about a business into a single conclusion, and that conclusion is what customers, lenders, partners, and buyers now encounter first. One unresolved complaint travels further and lasts longer than it once did.



That makes reputation infrastructure. It deserves the seriousness a company gives its balance sheet. We acquire the operators doing this work, we hold them for the long term, and we build shared systems underneath them so each one runs better than it did standing alone.



Our portfolio today includes RealRep and Sterling Name. We are growing quickly, and the operating machinery needs an owner.



Learn more at 
/



Role Overview



We are seeking an Operations Manager to run the day-to-day machinery of the business. You will work directly with our CEO, a serial entrepreneur who built and sold a manufacturing software company to a public acquirer, as the operating layer across every portfolio brand.



This is a generalist role for someone who is good at several things at once: managing an outside marketing vendor and holding it to deliverables, running shared inboxes so nothing is missed, keeping Airtable databases accurate enough to run a business on, getting invoices out and cash collected, and chasing down the details that keep an operating company clean. We are looking for the person who ends up owning whatever needs owning.



You are the system. You manage our marketing vendor and its deliverables, you run the inboxes and route what matters, you own the Airtable bases where our client and workflow data lives, you get invoices out on time and collections handled, you produce the weekly numbers the leadership team runs on, and you write down how all of it works so it survives you being on vacation.



We run on a weekly cadence: numbers in before the Level 10 meeting, off-track items go to the issues list, quarterly planning resets the targets. Your work shows up in those numbers every week.



The right person is organized to the point of being a little obsessive, writes crisp professional English, and is comfortable holding vendors and teammates to a commitment. You will be reading client accounts, vendor reports, and aging receivables all day and d
 what needs attention first.



This role starts as an individual contributor and grows into leading a team. As we systematize the work, you will recruit, hire, train, and manage the people who take pieces of it from you.



Primary Responsibilities



Marketing Vendor Management (20%)



* Own the relationship with our outside marketing vendor as the single point of contact and accountability

* Maintain the deliverables schedule: what is due, when it is due, what was actually delivered, and what is outstanding

* Run the standing vendor call: set the agenda, drive the discussion, capture decisions and owners, circulate notes the same day

* Review every deliverable against the brief before it goes live, including landing pages, ad creative,
 campaigns, and content

* Track marketing spend against budget and flag variances before they become surprises

* Maintain the performance reporting: spend, leads, cost per lead, conversion to client, and channel performance over time

* Escalate underperformance with data rather than impressions, and hold the vendor to agreed remedies

* Keep a running log of vendor commitments, changes in scope, and contract terms



Inbox & Client Communications (20%)



* Own the shared inboxes across brands, with every message triaged, routed, assigned, and closed out

* Maintain a clear triage standard: what gets answered directly, what routes to the CEO, what routes to the service team, and what escalates

* Catch and route revenue-relevant messages, including upsell signals, renewal questions, and at-risk clients, so they reach the right person the same day

* Draft professional replies on behalf of the business, and draft in the CEO's voice where he is the sender

* Maintain response-time standards and report against them weekly

* Build and maintain templates, canned responses, and routing rules so the inbox gets faster over time

* Keep a clean handoff record so anyone picking up a thread has the full history



Airtable Systems & Data Integrity (20%)



* Own our Airtable bases as the single source of truth for clients, engagements, workflow status, and vendor deliverables

* Keep every record current: client status, service tier, start date, active work items, and outcomes

* Build and maintain views, filters, and dashboards that each function actually uses

* Design and maintain automations that remove manual steps, including status changes, notifications, and recurring task creation

* Audit the data on a set schedule and fix what is wrong, with a written note on the root cause

* Build new tables and workflows as the business adds services and brands, rather than bolting them onto existing structures

* Connect Airtable to the other tools in the stack so data flows without re-entry



Invoicing, AR & Collections (20%)



* Run the invoicing cycle end to end: prepare, review, send, and confirm receipt, on schedule, every cycle

* Verify every invoice against the service actually delivered before it goes out

* Own accounts receivable: track aging, run the follow-up cadence, and escalate accounts that pass the agreed threshold

* Drive the collection rate and reduce aged receivables, working the list weekly rather than monthly

* Handle billing questions and disputes professionally, and document every resolution

* Manage payment failures, card updates, and subscription changes

* Coordinate with our bookkeeper and finance team on coding, reconciliation, and month-end close

* Track and reconcile recurring vendor and software expenses



Reporting & Scorecard (10%)



* Own the weekly scorecard entries for the metrics assigned to you, entered before the leadership meeting every week

* Produce the weekly operating report: client base, new starts, work completed, receivables, marketing performance, and open issues

* Maintain written definitions for every number you own, including what it measures and where it comes from

* Investigate variances and bring the explanation alongside the number

* Support quarterly planning with the historical data and trend analysis the team needs



Process Documentation & Team Building (10%)



* Document every recurring process as a written SOP that someone else could follow on day one

* Maintain a process library that stays current as the work changes

* Identify the tasks that should be delegated first as volume grows

* Recruit, interview, and onboard your own team members as the role expands, including writing job descriptions, screening candidates, and running training

* Manage, review, and develop the people who report to you

* Build the quality checks that let you trust delegated work without redoing it



Required Qualifications



Essential Experience



* 5+ years in operations, account management, executive support, or business administration, ideally at a services, agency, or B2B firm

* Vendor or agency management. You have personally held an outside vendor to a deliverables schedule, and you can describe how you ran it.

* Database ownership. You have been responsible for the accuracy of a business-critical database or CRM, and you can describe the system you kept it clean with. Airtable experience is strongly preferred.

* Invoicing and collections. You have owned a billing cycle and worked an aging receivables list, with results you can point to.

* Inbox ownership. You have run a shared or executive inbox at volume, with a triage standard you designed or maintained.

* US market experience. You have worked with US-based clients, companies, or teams and understand US business norms.

* Process discipline. You have written SOPs that other people actually used, and you follow a rule even when it is inconvenient.

* Multi-stream workload. You have held five or more distinct areas of responsibility at once without dropping any of them.



Core Skills



* Exceptional written English at native or near-native level, since you will be writing to US clients and drafting in an executive's voice

* Extreme organizational discipline, with everything tracked, logged, and closed out

* Genuine fluency with Airtable or a comparable relational tool, including views, automations, and linked records

* Comfort with basic business finance vocabulary: invoicing, accounts receivable, aging, collection rate, recurring revenue, churn, cost per acquisition

* Strong spreadsheet skills in Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables and lookups

* Self-directed, since you will get context and priorities and work out the steps yourself

* Sound judgment about tone and escalation, including knowing when to hold something and ask

* Willingness to be direct with a vendor or a teammate who has missed a commitment

* Available for standing calls during US Pacific business hours (evening or early morning in your timezone) and responsive on Slack during agreed overlap hours



Highly Valued



* Experience at an agency, BPO, or professional services firm where client delivery and billing were linked

* Experience in online reputation management, review management, SEO, digital marketing, or local services

* Airtable automations, scripting, or interface design

* Experience with EOS or a similar operating system, including scorecards, Level 10 meetings, and quarterly planning

* Hiring and managing a remote team, even a small one

* Familiarity with QuickBooks, Stripe, or a subscription billing platform

* Experience with Zapier, Make, or similar automation tools

* Comfort building simple dashboards and reports from raw data



Work Environment & Tools



Setup:



* Fully remote, with required overlap for standing calls during US Pacific business hours

* Full time at 40 hours per week

* Primarily asynchronous communication via Slack and

* Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet space for calls are required



Tools You'll Use:



* Airtable for client, workflow, and vendor databases

* Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Calendar)

* Slack for team communication

* QuickBooks and our billing and payment platforms

* Project and task management tools

* Reporting and dashboard tools

* Automation tools such as Zapier or Make



Engagement & Compensation



* Full-time engagement, paid monthly

* Competitive rate based on experience, discussed during the interview process

* Performance bonus tied to the operating metrics you own

* Compensation and scope expand as the role grows into team leadership



Rules of the Road



You will be inside client accounts, financial data, and vendor contracts. These are firm:



* Client information stays confidential, both the fact of the engagement and anything within it

* Every service platform we work with has terms, and we follow them exactly. When a shortcut would violate a platform's rules, we take the longer path.

* Spend commitments and contract changes come from the CEO

* Financial records get documented at the time, not reconstructed later

* Anything you correct in the data gets a written note explaining the root cause, so we fix the source

* When something is ambiguous, ask before acting



You will receive written guidelines covering all of this, and training.



How We Measure Success



* Vendor accountability: deliverables shipped on schedule, marketing spend within budget, cost per acquisition trending down

* Inbox performance: response time within standard, zero missed revenue-relevant messages, inbox cleared to a defined state daily

* Data integrity: every client record current and correct, audits clean, no decisions made on stale data

* Collections: collection rate within the payment window, aged receivables reduced, invoices out on schedule every cycle

* Reporting: scorecard entries complete and on time every week, with variances explained

* Documentation: every recurring process has a current written SOP

* Team growth: people hired, trained, and producing at standard as the role expands

title: Product & Market Feasibility Researcher

⚬ Unstructured Data Feasibility Assessment: Evaluate the technical parameters, cost, and reliability of ingesting, parsing, and structuring highly fragmented public-sector data feeds using modern LLMs, web scraping, and third-party APIs.

⚬ Competitive & Regulatory Mapping: Map the landscape of legacy software, point-solution tools, and tech-enabled service providers. Identify legal guardrails and licensing requirements for software-driven risk guidance.

⚬ Go-To-Market (GTM) & Distribution Modeling: Analyze customer acquisition channels (direct vs. partner/channel distribution) to model realistic CAC, pricing tiers, and top-of-funnel content wedge strategies.

Qualifications

⚬ 4+ years in management consulting, venture building, startup product strategy, or market intelligence (experience in RegTech, LegalTech, HRTech, or B2B SaaS preferred).

⚬ Demonstrated experience designing technical feasibility studies for unstructured data pipelines and AI/LLM parsing workflows.

⚬ Strong primary research skills, including cold outreach, customer discovery interviews, and synthesizing qualitative data into actionable strategy.

⚬ Familiarity with B2B SaaS financial modeling, unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback periods), and channel partnership strategies.

Deliverables

⚬ Market Feasibility & Competitor Matrix: Synthesized findings on current market gaps, target segment profiles, and competitive moats.

⚬ Technical Ingestion Blueprint: High-level feasibility assessment on public data availability, technical bottlenecks, and preliminary build-vs-buy data costs.

• B-roll-led ads: Voiceovers paired with relevant supporting scenes, product close-ups and demonstrations.



• Motion graphics and animated explainers: Animated text, illustrations and product previews that communicate ideas clearly.



• Real footage + AI: Combine supplied creator footage and actual product assets with AI-generated scenes.



• Product demonstrations: Show how printable learning materials are downloaded, printed and used.



• Longer sales explainers: Introduce the product, explain its benefits, answer common questions and finish with a clear call to action.



• Creative variations: Develop different hooks, openings, visuals, pacing and endings for testing.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Take supplied scripts and briefs through AI generation, voiceover production, editing and final export.

• Write and refine prompts to produce suitable footage and images.

• Check AI outputs and correct unnatural movement, inconsistent characters, poor lip-sync and other visual errors.

• Create strong openings, clear storytelling, readable captions and balanced audio.

• Keep product pages, text and demonstrations accurate to the supplied materials.

• Apply feedback consistently and improve future edits using ad results shared by our marketer.

• Suggest new formats and ways to improve production speed.

• Keep editable projects, prompts and source assets organized.

• Communicate clearly and deliver work reliably.



TOOLS AND EXPERIENCE



Our intended workflow uses:



• Higgsfield and Kie AI for AI content generation.

• ElevenLabs for voiceovers.

• CapCut for editing and finishing.



Tell us which tools you have used and show what you can produce. Experience with comparable platforms is welcome.



You should have:

• A strong portfolio of AI-generated videos and video ads.

• Experience with ecommerce or direct-response advertising.

• An understanding of hooks, pacing, viewer retention and calls to action.

• Good English comprehension and attention to detail.

• The ability to solve production problems independently.



Experience with educational products or advertising to parents is a plus.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



• Scripts, creative briefs and reference ads.

• Product assets and clear feedback.

• Access to the required AI tools.

• Advertising performance feedback to help you improve your work.



COMPENSATION AND WORKLOAD



USD $1,000/month.

Full-time, remote, 40 hours per week.



We expect consistent daily production of finished ads and creative variations. Production targets will reflect video length, complexity and demonstrated speed during the paid trial. Quality checks and revisions are part of the work.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with “AI EDUCATION” and include:



1. Three direct links to relevant video ads you personally worked on, showing different styles. Include at least two examples with AI-generated content.



2. Your contribution, tools used and approximate production time for each example.



3. A brief explanation or short screen recording of your workflow, from receiving a script to delivering the finished ad.



4. One ad you admire and 3–5 sentences explaining why you think it works.



5. Your typical turnaround time for a 30–60-second ad when scripts and assets are supplied. State how many original ads and additional hook variations you can realistically complete in an eight-hour day.



6. Your availability and earliest start date.



Relevant video samples are required. Please identify any collaborative work clearly.



Shortlisted applicants will have a short interview followed by a small paid trial. Payment and deliverables will be agreed before starting.



Our brand identity and full product details will be shared with the selected hire. Recruitment trials will use a generic sample brief.

title: Full-Time WFH Client Coach (Giving Feedback) — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Website and Wholesale Platform Assistant
description:
E-Commerce, Wholesale & Social Media Assistant



Australian Chocolate & Confectionery Brand | 20 Hours Per Week | Potential to Grow Full-Time



About Us



Charlotte Piper is a growing Australian-owned chocolate and confectionery brand based in regional Victoria, Australia.



We manufacture handmade chocolates, fudge and confectionery and supply customers throughout Australia and New Zealand through our website, wholesale customers, distributors and online wholesale platforms.



We are looking for an experienced, reliable and proactive person to join our team remotely and help manage and grow the online side of our business.



This is not simply a data-entry or “wait to be told what to do” position.



We want someone who will take the time to understand Charlotte Piper, learn our products and brand, follow our guidelines and think outside the square. We value someone who notices opportunities, suggests improvements and brings new ideas to the table.



What You'll Be Doing



Your role will include:



Managing and updating our e-commerce website, including products, pricing, images, descriptions, collections and promotional content.

Assisting with our planned transition from our current website platform to Shopify, so good Shopify knowledge and experience is important.

Managing and updating our wholesale platforms, including Ordermentum, Faire and other B2B platforms.

Ensuring pricing, product information, descriptions and images are accurate and consistent across all platforms.

Creating and scheduling content for
 and Instagram in keeping with our brand.

Creating
 newsletters and promotional campaigns.

Helping plan promotions for new products, seasonal ranges and key Australian retail occasions.

Keeping our website fresh, current and appealing.

Helping improve the way our products are presented and promoted online.

Looking for opportunities to increase engagement, online sales and wholesale sales.

Coming to us with new ideas and suggestions, rather than always waiting for instructions.

Following our brand guidelines and maintaining a consistent Charlotte Piper look, feel and tone of voice.

Assisting with other online, marketing and administrative tasks as required.

The Person We're Looking For



A major requirement for this position is a strong understanding of the Australian market and Australian communication style.



Previous experience working remotely for an Australian business or Australian brand is highly preferred.



You must have excellent written English and understand how Australians naturally communicate and word things. Our social media posts, newsletters, website copy and customer-facing content need to sound natural to an Australian audience — not overly formal, generic or obviously AI-generated.



We are looking for someone who:



Is proactive and uses initiative.

Can think creatively and outside the square.

Doesn't need to be given a task every minute of the day.

Can identify something that could be improved and bring it to our attention.

Comes up with ideas to help promote products and grow the brand.

Has excellent attention to detail.

Is organised, reliable and consistent.

Can work independently while still communicating well with our team.

Understands the importance of following brand guidelines.

Can take feedback and adapt their work accordingly.

Understands that we are a busy small business and priorities can sometimes change quickly.

Skills & Experience



Experience in the following would be highly regarded:



Shopify

E-commerce website management

Ordermentum

Faire

Wholesale/B2B platforms

 and Instagram

Meta Business Suite

 marketing and newsletters

Canva

Xero

Product uploading and online merchandising

Basic image editing and content creation

Australian retail, food, confectionery, giftware or FMCG businesses



You don't need to have used every platform listed above. We would rather find someone with strong e-commerce and digital skills, excellent attention to detail and the ability to learn quickly.



Hours & Availability



This position will initially be approximately 20 hours per week.



For the right person, once we have seen the quality of your work, reliability, initiative and how well you fit with our business, there is the opportunity for the position to develop into a full-time role.



You must be able to work agreed hours that overlap with our normal working day in Victoria, Australia (AEST/AEDT). We need someone who is available when our team is working rather than completing all work outside Australian business hours.



When applying, please tell us:

What experience you have working with Australian businesses or brands.

Your level of experience with Shopify.

What social media, newsletter and e-commerce platforms you have worked with.

Your availability during Victorian/Australian business hours.



And most importantly: tell us three ideas you would bring to Charlotte Piper to help an Australian chocolate brand increase online sales, promote its products and improve social media engagement.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a valuable part of our team, understands our brand and can grow with us.

• Hair play/client content

title: Graphic Designer (Apparel) + Shopify Store Assistant
description:

About us

XMartial is a combat sports apparel brand (Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, MMA, Muay Thai). We have served over 100,000 customers in 50+ countries with distinctive designs and high-quality gear. We move fast, we ship often, and our designs are the reason people buy from us instead of everyone else.



What this role is

You design our apparel. Rashguards, shorts, spats, gis, tees: you create the vector artwork, build the print files, and produce the mockups that go live on the store and into our ads.



Design is the core of the job and where most of your week goes. The rest of your time you work as a general store assistant, supporting whatever the store needs that week: uploading and organizing products in Shopify, resizing and preparing images, editing banners, fixing catalog issues, and other hands-on tasks.



This is an independent role. We give you the brief, the references, and the print specs, and trust you to deliver finished, production-ready work without being chased.



What you will do

Apparel design (the main job) + Shopify Store Assistant



Create original vector artwork for all-over-print combat sports apparel: rashguards, shorts, spats, gis, tees.

Build print-ready files that match manufacturer specs: correct dimensions, resolution, bleed, panel placement, and seam alignment across sizes.

Develop colorways and variations of existing designs, and keep whole collections visually consistent.

Work from a brief and from our existing style, while bringing your own ideas for designs you think will sell.



Mockups and visuals

Produce clean, realistic product mockups for the store, ads, and social.

Retouch and edit imagery in Photoshop so the catalog looks consistent and premium.

Create supporting graphics when needed: collection banners, promo images, product-page graphics.



General store assistant work

Upload and organize products in Shopify: images, variants, collections, tidying up messy or duplicate listings.

Prepare and resize assets for different placements across the store and ad channels.

Handle small ongoing tasks that keep the store accurate and up to date.



What we are looking for

Must have

Strong vector design skills in Adobe Illustrator. This is the core skill and we will test it.

Real experience designing apparel for print, ideally all-over sublimation. You understand how a flat file becomes a finished garment.

Photoshop skills for mockups and image retouching.

A portfolio of apparel or graphic design work. Required, no exceptions.

A strong eye for bold, modern design that fits combat sports culture.

Precision. Print files that are off by a few millimeters cost us real money, so details matter.

Willingness to do the non-design store tasks as well. This is not a pure design role.

Good written English and reliable communication.



Nice to have

You train BJJ, MMA, Muay Thai, or wrestling, or you genuinely follow the sport.

Shopify experience.

Comfort using AI tools (image generation, upscaling, background removal) to work faster.

Figma, or experience building tech packs and working directly with manufacturers.



How we work

Before each project we agree on the brief, the references, and the specs, so nothing is fuzzy. We move fast and ship often. Strong applicants get a short paid trial task (one rashguard design plus a mockup) before we finalize.



How to apply

All applications go through our form. We do not accept applications by
 or DM.



Apply here: 



Have your portfolio ready, with at least a few apparel or print designs in it. To show you read this far, the form asks for a keyword: it is GRIP. Applications with the wrong or missing keyword are not reviewed.

title: Social Media Clipper Needed — Marketing Agency for Contractors (TikTok/Instagram)
description:
Type: Part-time to start, with potential to move to full-time as workload grows | Remote



Platforms: TikTok, Instagram Reels



About Us:

We're a marketing agency that helps contractors (home services businesses — landscaping, remodeling, roofing, pools, etc.) grow through content and lead generation. Part of our strategy is building our own agency page — real, relatable content that builds trust with contractors before they ever talk to us directly. We're not trying to look like a billboard.



What We Need:

A reliable clipper to turn raw footage into short-form content. Most of our footage comes from on-site interviews with contractors — real conversations filmed in person — plus us talking on camera while on-site, b-roll of job sites and finished projects, and straight talking-head clips. If you're reading this closely, start your application message with the word BLUE as the very first word — it tells us you actually read the whole post instead of skimming. Your job as the clipper is to find the strongest moments in this raw footage and turn them into clips with strong hooks, clean captions, and tight pacing.



This starts as a part-time role, but as we scale our content and add more clients, we're looking to grow this into a full-time position for the right person.



What You'll Be Doing:



Review raw interview and on-site footage

Identify the best hooks and moments — a sharp quote, a surprising stat, a contrarian line, whatever grabs attention in the first 1-2 seconds

Edit with captions, trims, and pacing (CapCut or similar)

Mix in b-roll and talking-head footage as needed

Follow reference accounts/style guides we'll provide



Requirements:



Experience editing short-form content for TikTok/Instagram

Strong sense for finding "the moment" in raw, unstructured footage — matters more than fancy editing

Comfortable with CapCut (or similar)

Good English comprehension

Reliable communication and turnaround



How to Apply:

We're not looking at portfolios alone — we want to see how you work with our actual content. Message us with your experience and rate expectations. We'll send you a short raw footage clip, and you'll edit it into 2-3 short clips (hook + captions) to send back along with your application.

title: Creative Director & Social Media Manager for Ecommerce Vanity Brand
description:
Creative Director & Social Media Manager



E-Commerce Furniture & Home Décor Brand



We are looking for a highly creative, trend-driven Creative Director & Social Media Manager to take ownership of our brand’s visual identity, social media presence, and content strategy.



This is not simply a “posting on social media” position. We are looking for someone who understands how to create attention, build a recognizable brand, and turn content into views, followers, engagement, and ultimately sales.



Our ideal candidate understands furniture, interior design, lifestyle content, e-commerce, short-form video, and the rapidly changing world of AI-powered content creation.



Key Responsibilities



Creative Direction & Brand Development



* Own and continuously improve the overall creative direction of the brand.

* Develop a premium, recognizable visual identity across social media, website, advertising, and campaigns.

* Create concepts for furniture launches, lifestyle campaigns, room transformations, seasonal campaigns, and promotions.

* Maintain consistent branding across Instagram, TikTok,
, Pinterest, and other channels.

* Develop creative concepts that make our furniture feel aspirational, desirable, and highly shareable.

* Direct product photography, UGC, AI-generated visuals, video concepts, and lifestyle content.



Social Media Management & Growth



* Manage the brand’s social media presence, particularly Instagram and TikTok.

* Create and maintain a consistent content calendar.

* Produce and publish Reels, TikToks, Stories, carousels, static posts, and other short-form content.

* Develop strategies specifically designed to increase organic reach and viral potential.

* Research trending sounds, formats, hooks, memes, editing styles, and emerging social trends.

* Analyze successful content from furniture, interior design, luxury lifestyle, and DTC brands and adapt winning concepts to our brand.

* Experiment aggressively with hooks, thumbnails, captions, posting times, formats, and creative concepts.

* Track views, shares, saves, engagement, follower growth, website traffic, and conversions.



AI Content Creation



A major part of this role will involve using AI to dramatically increase the speed and quality of our creative production.



You should be comfortable using or quickly learning tools for:



* AI-generated lifestyle and interior-design imagery.

* Placing our actual furniture products into realistic AI-generated rooms and environments.

* AI video generation and animation.

* Turning static furniture images into engaging video content.

* AI models/virtual influencers and lifestyle scenes where appropriate.

* AI voiceovers, scripts, captions, hooks, and storytelling.

* AI-assisted video editing and content repurposing.

* Generating multiple creative variations for rapid testing.

* Using AI to transform a limited amount of raw product content into a large volume of high-quality social assets.



Experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Veo, Sora, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or similar platforms is highly valuable.



We don’t expect someone to know every AI platform. We care more about your ability to experiment with new technology and consistently produce content that looks good and performs.



Viral Content Strategy



You should understand that viral content is not random.



We want someone who actively studies:



* The first 1–3 second hook.

* Watch time and retention.

* Scroll-stopping visuals.

* Storytelling.

* Curiosity and pattern interruption.

* Shareability and saveability.

* Trending formats and sounds.

* Before/after transformations.

* Satisfying furniture assembly and transformation videos.

* Interior design inspiration.

* Luxury/aspirational lifestyle content.

* UGC and creator-style content.



Your goal will be to continuously test concepts and identify repeatable content formats capable of generating hundreds of thousands or millions of views.



Influencer & UGC Strategy



* Identify and recruit relevant creators, influencers, interior designers, homeowners, and UGC creators.

* Develop creative briefs that give creators clear hooks and concepts rather than simply asking for generic product videos.

* Repurpose creator content across organic social media and paid advertising.

* Build long-term relationships with high-performing creators.

* Identify opportunities for collaborations, giveaways, product placements, and viral campaigns.



E-Commerce & Performance Creative



This position should understand that great creative ultimately needs to support revenue.



You will work closely with the e-commerce and advertising teams to:



* Develop creative concepts for Meta, TikTok, and other paid advertising channels.

* Turn winning organic posts into advertising concepts.

* Produce multiple variations of successful creatives.

* Develop product launch campaigns.

* Create content around promotions, limited inventory, new arrivals, bundles, and seasonal events.

* Improve the connection between social media content and the customer’s purchasing journey.



What We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Extremely creative and visually driven.

* Obsessed with social media, trends, and internet culture.

* Experienced with Instagram Reels and TikTok.

* Comfortable experimenting with AI.

* Familiar with furniture, home décor, interior design, fashion, beauty, luxury, or another highly visual DTC category.

* Able to create content personally—not simply manage other people.

* Strong at video editing and visual storytelling.

* Able to recognize why one video receives 5,000 views while another receives 500,000+.

* Comfortable testing ideas quickly instead of waiting for everything to be perfect.

* Data-driven enough to analyze performance and adjust strategy.

* Highly organized and able to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.



Success in This Role



Performance will be evaluated based on measurable growth, including:



Organic reach • Video views • Engagement • Shares & saves • Follower growth • Viral posts • Website traffic • Content-driven sales • Creative output • UGC volume • Brand consistency



We are looking for someone who wants to build a brand, not simply manage an account.



You will have significant creative freedom to test ideas, introduce new AI technologies, develop campaigns, and help shape the visual identity of a growing e-commerce furniture company.



To Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio or social media accounts you have managed.

2. Examples of Reels/TikToks or other content you personally created.

3. Examples of content that achieved strong organic reach or went viral.

4. AI-generated images or videos you have created, if available.

5. A short explanation of what you would do during your first 30 days to grow an e-commerce furniture brand on Instagram and TikTok.



Bonus: Send us 2–3 content ideas you believe could go viral for a furniture brand.
