title: Customer Service Agent - Shopify Dropshipping Europe
description:
CUSTOMER SERVICE AGENT - SHOPIFY DROPSHIPPING 
 SUPPORT)



We run several Shopify dropshipping stores in Europe and are looking for a reliable
 support agent to join our team.



This is an
 support role. You handle customer
s, work from our

templates and documented workflows, log refunds in Google Sheets, and

escalate complex cases.



You MUST already have experience doing customer service for dropshipping

stores. Applications without it will not be considered.



=====================================================

START NOW: BACKLOG WORK AVAILABLE

=====================================================



We currently have a backlog of around 400 unanswered
s. Whoever starts

with us clears this first.



That means significantly more hours and more pay in your first week than in

a normal week - as many hours per day as you can realistically handle at a

good quality level. After the backlog is cleared, the role settles into the

regular part-time schedule below.



If you are available for long days this week, say so clearly in your

application. It is the fastest way to start.



=====================================================

WHAT YOU WILL DO

=====================================================



- Answer customer
s for our Shopify dropshipping stores

- Keep a steady pace of around 20 answered
s per hour

- Handle order questions, shipping updates, returns, refunds, lost

  packages and defective product claims

- Use DeepL to translate customer
s

- Use the correct template, and personalize the reply if needed

- Build and refine your own ChatGPT prompt so each
 is written for

  that specific customer and situation

- Handle refund requests using our step-by-step compensation ladder

- Keep customers calm so cases do not turn into disputes or chargebacks

- Log refunds and important cases in Google Sheets

- Escalate unclear, aggressive or complex cases through Slack

- Coordinate with the other CS team member so work is divided properly

- Leave your assigned inbox cleared at the end of every session



=====================================================

REFUNDS AND THE RESOLUTION LADDER

=====================================================



Refunds hit our margin directly, so a real part of this role is solving

problems properly instead of handing out money by default.



We work with a fixed ladder and you always start at the lowest step:



  Step 1 - 20% partial refund (standard first offer). or return to supplier in china

  Step 2 - 40% partial refund (only if the customer declines step 1) or return to supplier in china

  Step 3 - 60% partial refund (final partial step, serious cases only) or return to supplier in china



Do not skip steps. Never jump to a higher percentage because it is faster

or easier. Our refund policy states they have to refund to China. They might be unhappy about this.



Every offer must be explained in a friendly, personalized message so the

customer feels heard and accepts the solution. Act like everything is fine.





=====================================================

REQUIREMENTS

=====================================================



- Proven experience with CS for Shopify dropshipping stores

- Experience supporting multiple stores at the same time is a big plus

- Excellent written English

- Able to follow workflows and templates exactly

- Confident handling refund conversations and sticking to the ladder

- Able to work at a fast, consistent pace

- Calm and professional with angry customers

- Comfortable with Gmail, Google Sheets, DeepL, Slack and ChatGPT

- Comfortable running Hubstaff during your shifts

- Reliable internet, available 6 days per week





=====================================================

LANGUAGES

=====================================================



You do NOT need to speak European languages



We use DeepL, pre-written templates and documented workflows. You need

strong English and the ability to correctly understand the customer's

problem after translation.





=====================================================

HOURS AND PAY

=====================================================



- Rate: $4 per hour

- First week: extended hours while clearing the backlog

- After that: around 2-3 hours per day, 6 days per week (12-18 hrs/week)

- More hours as the workload grows - we are adding new stores

- Rate review after your first month, based on speed and refund rate

- Paid weekly via Wise, based on hours tracked in Hubstaff



The schedule is not fully flexible. You work alongside another CS team

member, so hours are coordinated to avoid overlap and keep the inbox

covered.





=====================================================

HOW WE MEASURE PERFORMANCE

=====================================================



Three things, in this order:



1. Quality - correct, personalized replies that actually close the case

2. Refund rate - how many cases you resolve at the lowest step of the ladder

3. Speed - around 20
s per hour once you know the system



Speed without the first two is worthless to us. A careless reply creates a

second
, a dispute, or a chargeback.





=====================================================

HOW TO APPLY

=====================================================



Reply with the following. Applications that skip items will be ignored.



1. Put the word MERIDIAN at the top of your message



2. A short introduction about yourself



3. Your dropshipping CS experience: which stores did you support? Include

   store names and links. If you cannot share links, say why.



4. How many
s did you answer PER HOUR in your last role? Per hour,

   not per day. Also tell us which type of
 took you the longest.



5. What was your average refund percentage, or the share of cases you

   closed at the first step? If you do not know, just say so - an honest

   "I never tracked that" is fine.



6. Which tools you have used: Gmail, Shopify, Google Sheets, Slack, DeepL,

   ChatGPT, Hubstaff, helpdesk software, etc.



7. Your time zone, how many hours per day you can work THIS WEEK, and how

   many per day long term



8. When you can start



9. A screenshot of your internet speed test from speedtest.net



10. Confirmation that you are comfortable with $4/hour and the 20
s

    per hour target



We are looking for someone reliable and long-term. If you do good work,

there are more hours and more responsibility available as we grow.

title: Career as AI Operations Architect for Non-Profit: Build the Systems To Power Life-Changing Mentorship & Adventure Travel
description:
$3.00–$4.00/hour starting salary reviewed after initial 3 months. 

Full-Time

Flexible Hours



Paid Trial-to-Permanent Role with Outcome Bonuses, Full Career Training and Support, as well as Long-Term Career Growth Opportunity with our organisation



The Mission



We operate a Young Adult Mentoring Network built around Fun and Adventure Travel Experiences.



Our Non-Profit guides young adults through transformative journeys that combine mentorship, personal development, and real-world adventure.



Our programs connect mentees with mentors, organize adventure-based learning experiences, manage family and community engagement, and track personal growth outcomes, all while scaling to serve more young people across multiple regions of the world.



Now we're expanding our operations into the Philippines and we need a systems architect to build AI efficiencies into our operational backbone from the ground up. Your local cultural awareness will be a plus for this expansion.



You are not maintaining existing workflows. This role is about reviewing our proposals, then supporting our team in designing, automating, and scaling entire operations: mentor-mentee matching, program delivery, adventure trip coordination, member and volunteer management, social media ecosystems, webinars, and community engagement, across multiple countries and cultures.



You'll work directly with the directors. You'll have maximum autonomy (we run on Holacracy principles). And if you execute with creativity and dedication, you'll be promoted to AI Tech Team Leader, building and recruiting your own team.



What You'll Actually Build



Mentor & Mentee Management Systems  

Automated matching, onboarding, progress tracking, and lifecycle management across Brilliant Directories, GHL, optional tools such as Fusebase, social media tools. Many other tools you can experiment with, test, and help us decide which tools can best support our teams goals.



Program Delivery Automation

Scalable infrastructure to coordinate mentorship programs, track participation, schedule sessions, and measure personal growth outcomes. Same processes will be used and tested by all internal teams as well, for our own personal growth, bug testing etc.



Adventure Travel Operations

Automated booking workflows, trip coordination, participant communication, and pre/post-adventure engagement sequences



Member & Volunteer Management

Self-service portals, automated communications, and community engagement tracking



Donor Operations

End-to-end donation workflows, receipt automation, stewardship sequences, and retention systems



Social Media Operations

Automated content distribution, engagement tracking, and follower growth systems across platforms



AI Agent Workflows

Custom AI automations for mentor matching, participant support, content generation, and internal knowledge management

Integration Architecture

Connect GHL, Fusebase, calendar systems, webinar tools, and AI platforms into a cohesive, self-running operation



The goal: 

Build and maintain systems so reliable and well-documented that the organization scales without depending on anyone remembering to manually push buttons so we can focus on changing lives, not managing spreadsheets.



Who This Is For

You're not looking for a job where you wait for tickets and execute tasks.



You're looking for a role where you:



Own the problem, not just the task

Design systems that actually work when they scale 2x, 5x, 10x

Can propose new tools, kill inefficient processes, and implement better ones without micromanagement



Want your work to matter, to help young adults find direction, mentorship, and life-changing experiences



Are excited by the challenge of expanding operations into the Philippines using your cultural and local knowledge



Have experience (or strong aptitude to learn) with n8n, Make.com, Zapier, GHL, AI agents, API integrations, and workflow automation



Think in systems: 

Where is the bottleneck? 

What should we automate? 

What happens when this breaks?

If you simply connect apps and call it automation, this isn't for you.

If you are ready for the challenge to join a friendly/caring team to help us design operations that make mission-driven work easier to run, we want to talk.



Your Growth Path

Phase 1: Execute 3 paid trial tasks @ $3.00/hr

Phase 2 (Month 1 to 3): Full-time implementation role

Phase 3 (Month 4+): Review for AI Tech Team Leader Role and increased salary and performance bonuses tied to organizational growth metrics (members served, communities reached, lives impacted). Help recruit, train, and lead your own automation team.



We measure our team's success by: 

Number of young adults mentored, adventure experiences delivered, operational efficiency gained, and systems built that don't break.



The Stack You'll Work With



CRM & Membership: GoHighLevel (GHL), Brilliant Directories, Fusebase (experimental only)

Automation: n8n, Make.com, Zapier, APIs, Webhooks etc.

AI: OpenAI, Claude, Local AI (experimental only), custom AI agents, prompt engineering

Operations: Calendar systems, webinar platforms, project management, SEO,
 and social media marketing tools

Data: Airtable, Google Sheets, databases



You don't need to know every tool. You need to be confident with tech, fast learner, adaptable, think systematically, and build things that last.



The Structure



Reporting: Directly with founding directors (we are easy going, dedicated to the mission, yet want to have fun with you and our team along the way)



Autonomy: 

Maximum. We are implementing Holacracy, a self-management system, encouraging self leadership, self responsibility, distributed authority, no micromanagement



Hours: 

Flexible. Discuss your needs with us.



Start: 

Immediate



Your Commitment:

3 paid trial tasks  resulting in Permanent role with benefits if it's a fit



How to Apply



Do not send a generic cover letter.



Send us:



One specific system you've built (or would build) that reduced manual work and scaled operations. What was the problem, what did you automate, what was the result?



Your thoughts on our stack.

What's one high leverage integration or automation you'd propose on Day 1 for a mentoring/adventure travel operation?



Your availability

When can you start the trial tasks?



We're hiring fast. 

If you're a empathic team player, a systems thinker, who wants to build something meaningful that benefits young people who need your/our support apply now.





We value reliability, documentation, and systems that don't create dependency. 



Build something that helps us mentor more young adults through the life-changing experiences we provide.

title: Paid Media & Tracking Assistant
description:
TO APPLY CLICK HERE: 



We are looking for a hands-on Paid Media & Tracking Assistant to support our digital advertising, analytics, and tracking efforts across multiple paid media platforms. The ideal candidate has practical experience setting up, maintaining, and troubleshooting advertising pixels, events, conversion tracking, and analytics systems, with a strong understanding of how paid traffic is measured and optimized.



You will work closely with the marketing team to ensure that campaigns are properly tracked, conversions are accurately recorded, and our tracking infrastructure provides reliable data for reporting and optimization. This role is particularly suited to someone who enjoys working directly with ad platforms, analytics tools, event tracking, and campaign data rather than focusing solely on strategy.



*Key Responsibilities

Set up, manage, and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

Support paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

Define and maintain a clear event tracking structure, including event names, parameters, properties, and conversion definitions.

Implement and validate pixels, events, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and other tracking solutions across websites and campaigns.

Work with the tracking stack, including PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Events Manager, Brevo, and Microsoft Clarity.

Monitor tracking performance and investigate discrepancies between advertising platforms, analytics tools, and website data.

Debug tracking issues and identify why an event or conversion is not firing correctly, rather than only setting up campaigns.

Test and validate events across different platforms to ensure that data is being captured accurately and consistently.

Ensure that key events and conversions are properly defined, recorded, and attributed across the relevant platforms.

Assist with campaign setup, audience tracking, retargeting, and conversion measurement.

Analyze campaign and tracking data to identify potential issues and opportunities for improvement.

Work with websites, landing pages, and analytics tools to ensure proper data collection and attribution.

Help maintain organized tracking documentation and ensure that event naming and tracking structures remain consistent.

Stay up to date with changes to advertising platforms, tracking technologies, attribution, and privacy requirements.

Support testing and troubleshooting of new tracking setups before campaigns go live.



*Preferred Experience

Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

Experience with TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

Practical experience with PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Microsoft Clarity, and Brevo.

Strong understanding of event tracking concepts, including event names, parameters, properties, conversion definitions, and attribution.

Experience troubleshooting tracking issues and identifying why events or conversions may not be firing, recording, or attributing correctly.

Familiarity with server-side tracking / Conversions API is a strong plus.

Experience with newer or emerging advertising platforms, including ChatGPT Ads, would be a significant advantage.

Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, dashboards, and campaign performance reports.

Strong attention to detail and a hands-on, problem-solving mindset.



*What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is practical, detail-oriented, and technically curious. You should be comfortable getting into the actual ad platforms and tracking tools, testing events yourself, investigating discrepancies, and figuring out why something is not working as expected.



The ideal candidate should be able to go beyond simply setting up campaigns or implementing pixels. They should understand how the entire tracking flow works, from defining an event and its parameters to ensuring that it fires correctly, is captured by the relevant analytics tools, and is ultimately reflected as a meaningful conversion.



You do not need to be an advanced developer, but you should be confident working with tracking tools, advertising platforms, basic website elements, and analytics systems. Experience working across multiple paid media channels and the ability to quickly learn and troubleshoot new platforms are highly valued.

title: Appraisal Coordinator (Remote)
description:
Role: Appraisal Coordinator 

Compensation: PHP 60,000–80,000 per month 

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Central Time (CT) 

Engagement: Full-time, long-term independent contractor 

Location: Remote 



About PahRoo 

PahRoo Appraisal and Consultancy is a Chicago-based real estate appraisal firm serving residential and commercial markets in Illinois and Texas. We work with Appraisal Management Companies (AMCs), direct lenders, and private clients. 



We operate in a results-focused environment where accountability, responsiveness, and high-quality execution matter. We are looking for experienced professionals who can take ownership of their work, make sound decisions, and keep clients informed without needing constant supervision. 



About the Role 



We are looking for an experienced Appraisal Coordinator to take ownership of our appraisal order pipeline from bid acceptance through final delivery and file closure. 



This is a senior operations role with meaningful decision-making responsibility. You will coordinate orders, communicate directly with clients, manage revisions and deadlines, and ensure our systems remain accurate and up to date. 



You will also manage incoming bid requests for standard residential assignments, provide quotes, and follow up consistently until each opportunity reaches a clear outcome. 



Success in this role means orders keep moving, clients know what is happening, and issues are identified and addressed before they become problems. 



What You’ll Own 



Appraisal Operations 



Manage the full appraisal order lifecycle in ANOW, from bid acceptance through delivery and file closure. 

Make independent bid decisions for standard residential assignments within established guidelines. 

Coordinate inspection scheduling and appraiser routing across the Chicago and Dallas markets. 

Deliver completed reports through AMC and client portals in required formats, including PDF, XML, and ENV/ENB formats as applicable. 

Manage revision requests from receipt through completion, including communicating requirements to report writers and providing clients with clear ETAs. 

Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready records in ANOW. 

Monitor active orders closely and proactively resolve delays, missing information, or other roadblocks. 



Bids and Sales Support 



Prepare quotes for standard residential appraisal assignments. 

Follow up consistently on outstanding bids until the client provides a clear yes or no. 

Record every bid, follow-up, and next action in Zoho CRM on the same day. 

Escalate new client entities and non-standard appraisal scopes to the appropriate relationship owner. 



Client Communication 

Serve as a day-to-day contact for client questions regarding order status, timing, and scope. 

Communicate proactively when delays, issues, or changes arise. 

Set clear and realistic expectations with clients. 

Escalate situations involving unrealistic turnaround requests, quality disputes, or relationship risks to the appropriate manager. 



What We’re Looking For 



To be successful in this role, you should have: 

At least 2 years of direct experience with a U.S.-based Appraisal Management Company (AMC) or U.S. appraisal office. 

Hands-on experience managing appraisal orders through multiple stages of the lifecycle. 

Client-facing experience involving quoting, follow-up, account support, or retention. 

Working knowledge of common appraisal products and assignments, including: 

1004 / URAR 

FHA 

Field Review 

New Construction 

Desktop appraisals 

Hands-on experience using ANOW, Mercury Network, Appraisal Inbox, or a comparable appraisal management platform. 

Strong CRM discipline and the ability to maintain accurate records and next steps in real time. 

Demonstrated ability to manage 20+ active appraisal orders simultaneously without sacrificing accuracy, responsiveness, or client communication. 

Strong written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate directly with U.S. clients. 

Strong organization, attention to detail, and independent problem-solving skills. 

Reliable internet access and a quiet, professional remote-work environment. 



What You’ll Get 



Competitive compensation for an experienced appraisal operations professional. 

A stable, long-term contractor opportunity rather than a short-term project. 

Direct access to company leadership. 

Meaningful ownership and influence over how our appraisal operations function. 

The opportunity to deepen your expertise in the U.S. appraisal industry and build highly transferable real estate operations skills. 

A results-focused environment that values ownership, initiative, and execution. 



How to Apply 



To help us understand your experience, please include the following with your application: 

Which appraisal order management platforms have you used? 

What is the highest number of active appraisal orders you have personally managed at one time? 



Then complete your full application here: 







Please note that applications must be submitted through the application link above to be considered.

Company: Mindful Discovery Therapeutic Solutions Inc.

Position:  Executive Assistant + Project Manager (hybrid role)

Employment type: Full-time, 40 hrs/week, direct hire  (you work with us, not through an agency)

Schedule: EST USA business hours, this means Philippine night shift; please only apply if you are genuinely comfortable with this long-term

Competitive Salary
USD PM + benefits below

Start: immediately



 Benefits



- Annual bonus equivalent to one month's pay, paid in December

- Paid time off after 90 days 

- HMO/health stipend after probation

- Monthly internet allowance

- Annual performance-based raises

- Long-term, stable role with a growth path to Operations Manager / Chief of Staff



About Us



Mindful Discovery Therapeutic Solutions Inc. is a growing therapy practice dedicated to helping people heal and thrive. Our CEO is currently wearing too many hats  clinical leadership, operations, and growth  and needs a highly capable right hand to take ownership of the calendar, follow-up, and project execution so the business can scale.



This is not a task-taker role. We're looking for a proactive operator who anticipates needs, closes loops without being reminded, and treats the CEO's time as the company's most valuable asset. We move fast and hold a high bar — and we treat our team with respect, invest in your growth, communicate kindly, and celebrate wins together. We're looking for someone who wants to stay and grow with us for years, not months.



What You'll Own



Executive Support (Day-to-Day)

- Full calendar management: scheduling, protecting deep-work time, resolving conflicts, and reorganizing priorities

-
 management to inbox zero: triaging, drafting responses, flagging what truly needs the CEO

- Meeting preparation: agendas, briefing notes, and pre-reads

- Attending meetings on the CEO's behalf when appropriate; taking notes, capturing action items, and sending recaps

- Follow-up tracking so commitments and deadlines don't fall through the cracks

- Document organization and file management

- Drafting correspondence and communications in the CEO's voice

- Expense tracking and basic invoicing support



Project Management

- Owning project timelines, deadlines, and deliverables across the company

- Following up with team members and vendors to keep projects moving without CEO involvement

- Creating and maintaining SOPs and process documentation

- Research, reporting, and preparing summaries for decision-making

- CRM upkeep and pipeline tracking

- Hiring support: sourcing candidates, screening, and scheduling interviews

- Onboarding coordination for new hires

title: Accounts Officer / Bookkeeper
description:
Role Overview The Accounts Officer / Bookkeeper is the guardian of our financial data integrity. The core purpose of this role is to manage the daily transactional volume of the business specifically Accounts Payable and Bank Reconciliations ensuring that our financial records are audit-ready at all times. You will act as the "preparer," ensuring that all data is correctly coded and reconciled so that the local Australian Accountant can focus on high-level analysis and statutory compliance (BAS/Tax Returns).



Primary Tasks



Accounts Payable (High Volume): Manage the "End-to-End" AP process: collecting invoices, verifying valid ABNs (Australian Business Numbers), coding expenses to the correct Chart of Accounts, and flagging discrepancies.

Payment Run Preparation: Prepare weekly "aba files" (Batch Payment Files) for the Director to approve, ensuring suppliers are paid on time and cash flow is managed.

Bank Reconciliation: Perform daily reconciliation of multiple bank accounts and credit cards in Xero/MYOB to ensure the "Statement Balance" matches the "Xero Balance."

GST Coding: Review every transaction to ensure the correct GST tax code is applied (e.g., distinguishing between 'GST on Expenses' vs 'GST Free' for NDIS/Medical supplies), preventing costly errors on our BAS.

Payroll Data Entry: Assist with timesheet collection and data entry into the payroll system (confirming hours and leave types) ready for the Payroll Manager to process.

Supplier Management: Act as the primary point of contact for supplier queries regarding payment status or invoice disputes.

Receipt Management: Manage the digital receipt capture system (Dext/Hubdoc) to ensure every transaction has a visible audit trail attached.

 



Required Experience



Australian Bookkeeping: Minimum 3 years of experience working with Australian companies, specifically dealing with GST regulations. You must know what a valid "Tax Invoice" looks like under Australian law.

Accounts Payable: Experience managing high-volume AP (50+ invoices a week) with high accuracy.

Payroll Administration: Familiarity with Australian payroll concepts (Superannuation, PAYG Withholding, Annual Leave accruals).

Cloud Accounting: Deep operational experience with cloud-based accounting software.

Required Education



Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Commerce (CPA candidate preferred but not essential).

Certification: Certified Xero Advisor or QuickBooks ProAdvisor is highly desirable.

Proficient English (Written) for communicating professionally with suppliers and the internal finance team.

Required Traits



Ethical & Honest: You are dealing with company money and sensitive data; absolute integrity is non-negotiable.

Detail-Obsessed: You are the person who spends 30 minutes looking for a $0.05 discrepancy in a reconciliation because "it has to balance."

Process Driven: You follow the approval hierarchy strictly and never bypass internal controls.

Inquisitive: If an invoice looks "weird" or a cost has spiked, you flag it rather than just processing it.

Required Software/Systems



General Ledger: Xero (Most common in Aus), MYOB Business, or QuickBooks Online.

OCR/Receipt Capture: Dext Prepare (formerly Receipt Bank) or Hubdoc.

Spreadsheets: Microsoft Excel (Intermediate to Advanced – VLOOKUP and Pivot Tables for AP analysis).

ApprovalMax (For purchase order workflows).

KeyPay / Employment Hero (Australian Payroll software).

EzzyBills (Invoice automation).

Calxa (For cash flow reporting, if assisting with reports).

title: Burnout B2B Sales Advisor
description:
Burnout B2B Sales Advisor



Part-Time | 10 Hours/Week Initially | $7/Hour + Commission



The Leadership Principle is seeking an experienced B2B Sales Advisor to help grow a professional-services offer focused on organizational burnout.



This role is for an experienced salesperson who can operate independently. You will prospect, qualify opportunities, conduct consultative sales conversations, manage follow-up, and close business with minimal day-to-day supervision.



This is not an appointment-setting-only role.



WHAT YOU WILL SELL



You will sell a $9,500, three-week B2B advisory engagement that helps leaders identify the organizational conditions creating burnout, understand the impact on people and performance, and build a focused 90-day action plan to address the underlying causes.



The Founder delivers the engagement after the sale.



WHO YOU WILL SELL TO



Typical buyers include Directors, Senior Directors, VPs, and other leaders responsible for teams, functions, transformation efforts, PMOs, or business units.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Develop opportunities through company-provided prospects and your own prospecting

• Conduct personalized B2B outreach

• Identify and engage appropriate business decision-makers

• Qualify need, authority, budget, timing, and fit

• Conduct consultative sales conversations

• Handle objections and maintain disciplined follow-up

• Manage your pipeline independently

• Move qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle

• Close business and secure client payment

• Hand paid clients to the Founder for delivery



COMPENSATION



Base Pay: $7/hour



Company-Sourced Business:

4% of net collected client revenue



Advisor-Sourced Business:

7% of net collected client revenue



Advisor-sourced opportunities earn the higher commission because the Advisor is responsible for originating and closing the business.



SCHEDULE



10 hours per week initially, with the opportunity to increase based on demonstrated performance and pipeline development.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• 5+ years of B2B sales or business development experience

• Demonstrated ability to manage a full sales cycle independently

• Experience generating and developing your own pipeline

• Experience selling higher-value B2B services or solutions

• Experience communicating with Director, VP, or executive-level buyers

• Strong written and spoken English

• Strong discovery, qualification, follow-up, and objection-handling skills

• Evidence of measurable sales results

• Ability to work independently with minimal day-to-day supervision



Experience selling consulting, advisory services, professional services, HR solutions, leadership services, organizational development, transformation services, or similar B2B offerings is especially relevant.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please answer the following:



1. How many years of direct B2B sales experience do you have, what products or services have you sold, and what was the typical price?



2. Describe one B2B sale you personally managed from prospecting or initial contact through close. Who was the buyer, and did you source the opportunity yourself or receive the lead from the company?



3. What measurable sales results can you share from your most recent or relevant sales role?

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



If you have never worked a graveyard shift before, think carefully before applying. We will ask you specifically how you plan to structure your sleep, and how you'll make the schedule work alongside your family or partner. "I'll figure it out" is not an answer that gets you hired. This shift is sustainable for people who plan for it and difficult for people who don't.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 15-minute pre-screen async interview

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance

title: Sales Floor Accountability Manager (Remote VA) — Lead Response Enforcement
description:
ABOUT US 🏠



We install whole-home water filtration and softening systems for homeowners across South Florida. About 30 installs a month at an average of $3,400 per job. Every lead costs us real money.



When a lead comes in and nobody calls it for two hours, that money is gone. That's the problem you're hired to kill.



THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE ⏱️



Every lead gets contacted within 60 seconds. You are the person who makes sure that happens — every time, every rep, every day.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Watch the lead queue live during your entire shift. New lead hits, your clock starts.

Track the 60-second window on every single lead assigned to a rep

Miss at 60 seconds → you immediately message the rep: "Lead #X is unworked. What's happening?"

No reply within 2 minutes → you pull the lead and reassign it to the next available rep online

Log every miss: which rep, which lead, how late, what the excuse was

Send the owner a daily scoreboard — response times by rep, misses, reassignments

Send a weekly report showing who's improving and who isn't

Flag repeat offenders to the owner. Same rep, same excuse, three times? Owner hears about it that day.

Confirm reps are actually logged in and available at the start of every shift



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT 🚫



You are not a salesperson. You don't close.

You are not a coach. You don't train reps.

You are not their friend. You're the referee.



You are the person who makes a grown adult uncomfortable about being late. If that sounds bad to you, don't apply.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR ✅



Required:



Thick skin. Reps will push back, make excuses, get annoyed at you. You hold the line anyway.

Obsessive about time. Seconds matter here, not minutes.

Comfortable holding adults accountable over chat and phone

Excellent written and spoken English

2+ years in operations, dispatch, team lead, QA, or a similar tracking role

You can sit on a live dashboard for hours without drifting

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, good headset

We get around 10-15 leads daily and have 5 sales reps



Nice to have:



Spanish

GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or similar CRM

Call center floor manager or dispatcher background

Home services, HVAC, plumbing, or roofing experience



WHAT WE OFFER 💰



Stable full-time position with a growing US company

Performance bonus tied to team average speed-to-lead. You push the number down, you get paid more.

Full authority to reassign leads. Nobody overrules you but me.





HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY ⚠️



Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed. This is on purpose. Attention to detail is the whole job.



Step 1 — Write "60 SECONDS" as the first two words of your application.



Step 2 — Tell us in a few sentences:



A time you had to hold someone accountable who didn't want to be held accountable. What happened?

Your internet speed (run a speed test, give us the number)

Your setup: headset, workspace, background noise

Your available hours in US Eastern Time

What CRMs or dashboards you've worked in



Step 3 — Record a voice sample (MOST IMPORTANT PART) 🎙️



Record yourself handling the scenario below like you're actually on the call. One continuous recording, 2–3 minutes.



Upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, or Vocaroo and paste the link. Make sure anyone can listen.



Do not write out the answer. Do not read a script in a flat voice. We want to hear how you actually sound.

title: Certified Building Designer & Design Integration Manager
description:
CERTIFIED BUILDING DESIGNER & DESIGN INTEGRATION MANAGER



Remote | Full-Time | US Residential Remodeling & Construction

$15–$22/hour depending on experience | Exceptional candidates up to approximately $25/hour

Performance bonus and profit-sharing potential



READ FIRST — TWO NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



1. CPBD CERTIFICATION

You must currently hold the Certified Professional Building Designer (CPBD) credential issued by the National Council of Building Designer Certification (NCBDC).



Do not apply unless you hold this exact credential. A Texas-licensed architect may also satisfy the professional qualification requirement.



2. EXTENSIVE US RESIDENTIAL EXPERIENCE

You must have extensive hands-on experience with US residential remodeling, additions, and/or custom homes.



Do not apply if your experience is primarily commercial, institutional, industrial, infrastructure, drafting-only, or non-US residential work.



ABOUT THE POSITION

We are seeking a senior Certified Building Designer & Design Integration Manager to take projects from early design through permitting and continue carrying the design and technical requirements through construction. This is a hands-on senior role. Initially, you will personally perform the design, zoning review, permitting, technical coordination, and design-integration work.



As the company grows, this position is expected to develop into leadership of the building-design function, including establishing standards, improving workflows, training junior designers, reviewing their work, and ultimately managing a design team.



The role is intentionally broader than production design. You will be responsible for keeping design coordinated with estimating, engineering, procurement, permitting, construction requirements, field conditions, and client decisions throughout the project lifecycle.



BUILDING DESIGN & PRECONSTRUCTION

Projects frequently begin before complete construction drawings exist. You must be comfortable developing projects from progressively improving information such as client requirements, site walkthroughs, photographs, 3D scans, existing-condition documentation, preliminary concepts, partial plans, and other project records.



Responsibilities include:

- Review client objectives, site conditions, 3D scans, preliminary budgets, and available project information.

- Review applicable zoning, historic-district requirements, overlays, setbacks, height limitations, building coverage, impervious cover, and other development restrictions.

- Develop conceptual site plans and floor plans.

- Develop 3D schematic studies where appropriate.

- Evaluate project footprint, flow, feasibility, and constructability.

- Prepare interior and exterior elevations.

- Develop technical details, schedules, specifications, and coordinated drawing sets.

- Incorporate structural, subcontractor, estimating, and field feedback into the design.

- Coordinate structural engineers and other consultants.

- Maintain design consistency as scope, pricing, selections, engineering, and field conditions evolve.

- Work closely with estimating so design and cost development proceed together rather than as disconnected processes.



ZONING & PERMITTING — DIRECT OWNERSHIP

This position will personally own the design side of zoning and permitting for assigned projects.



Responsibilities include:

- Determine applicable zoning and development requirements.

- Identify zoning or permitting constraints early in design.

- Prepare permit-ready architectural documents.

- Assemble and submit permit applications.

- Coordinate required engineering and supporting documentation.

- Track permit progress.

- Review municipal plan-review comments.

- Coordinate responses with engineers and other consultants.

- Revise drawings in response to review comments.

- Prepare and submit permit revisions.

- Maintain organized records of comments, revisions, approvals, and outstanding permit conditions.



The role is expected to carry projects through the permit process rather than simply prepare drawings for someone else to manage.



DESIGN INTEGRATION DURING CONSTRUCTION

The role continues through construction. You will be responsible for maintaining continuity between the approved design and actual construction by coordinating the technical information required by the field team, Project Manager, estimators, engineers, subcontractors, and suppliers.



Responsibilities include:

- Manage design-related RFIs and technical questions.

- Coordinate submittals and shop drawings.

- Prepare supplemental drawings, details, and clarifications.

- Resolve drawing conflicts and design discrepancies.

- Coordinate engineering responses and consultant information.

- Prepare design and permit revisions caused by field conditions or approved changes.

- Maintain current drawing, specification, and revision records.

- Track unresolved design decisions and technical dependencies.

- Coordinate technical information required for procurement and fabrication.

- Review technical substitutions and proposed alternatives.

- Support client selection and specification coordination.

- Identify design-related schedule constraints before they affect construction.

- Support project schedule updates with design, permitting, approval, and procurement dependencies.

- Participate in project meetings where technical or design issues require resolution.

- Support closeout documentation and as-built information.



The objective is to ensure that design is actively integrated into execution rather than handed off and forgotten once construction begins.



CABINETRY & CNC — STRONG PREFERENCE

Strong preference will be given to candidates with significant cabinetry and architectural millwork design experience, particularly:

- Kitchens

- Bathroom vanities

- Closets

- Built-ins

- Custom architectural millwork

- Shop and production drawings

- Cabinet construction and hardware

- Cut lists and optimization

- CNC-ready production files

- CNC machine files or toolpaths



Candidates capable of taking cabinetry from design through fabrication-ready CNC output will receive significant preference.



SYSTEMS DEVELOPMENT & FUTURE LEADERSHIP

This position is expected to grow into leadership of the building-design function.



Responsibilities are expected to expand to include:

- Establishing drawing and documentation standards

- Developing design QA/QC procedures

- Refining zoning and permitting workflows

- Creating reusable drawing standards and templates

- Improving design-to-estimating handoffs

- Improving design-to-construction handoffs

- Documenting repeatable processes

- Developing standards for RFIs, submittals, revisions, and technical coordination



The long-term objective is for this person to become the senior leader of a growing residential building-design function.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Current Certified Professional Building Designer (CPBD) credential issued by NCBDC, or Texas architectural licensure

- Extensive hands-on experience designing and supporting US residential remodeling, additions, and custom homes

- Demonstrated ability to independently develop residential projects from early concept through construction documents and permitting

- Strong knowledge of US residential construction methods, detailing, constructability, zoning, and permitting

- Experience coordinating engineers, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, and field teams during both preconstruction and construction

- Strong professional English communication

- Ability to work full-time with substantial overlap with US Central Time



COMPENSATION

$15–$22/hour, depending on experience and demonstrated capability.



Exceptional candidates with especially strong US residential remodeling/building experience, permitting and zoning competency, cabinet/CNC capability, and leadership experience may be considered at approximately $25/hour.



The position also offers potential performance bonuses and profit sharing as responsibilities expand and the role develops into department leadership.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS

Please answer these questions directly in your application:



1. Do you currently hold the Certified Professional Building Designer (CPBD) credential issued by the National Council of Building Designer Certification (NCBDC)? If yes, provide your certification number and current status. If you are instead a Texas-licensed architect, provide your Texas license information.



2. How many years of US residential remodeling, addition, and custom-home design experience do you have? Briefly describe the types and approximate number of US residential projects you have personally handled.



3. Describe one US residential remodeling, addition, or custom-home project that you personally carried from early concept or incomplete information through construction documents, permitting, and construction-phase design coordination.



4. Describe your cabinet and millwork design experience, including whether you have personally created CNC-ready production files or toolpaths.



5. Please provide a portfolio showing US residential design documents and, if applicable, cabinetry, millwork, or CNC-related work.

understand the objective → investigate → d

WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY WORK ON

This is a product that exists and works. The job is finishing it, not architecting it.



- UI polish and consistency across list views, detail pages, and forms: spacing, typography, alignment, empty states, loading states

- Fixing layout defects: horizontal overflow on data tables, responsive breakpoints, mobile behavior

- End-to-end and integration test coverage (Playwright preferred) for billing, enrollment, and attendance flows

- Bug triage and fixes from a running backlog

- Building out remaining screens and features: customer portal surfaces, registration forms, staff messaging, parts of billing, AI components, APIs

- Manual QA passes against a dedicated test environment, with written reproduction steps



REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years building production web applications, with at least 1 year in React

- Real, demonstrable Next.js App Router experience: server components, server actions, route handlers. Pages Router only is not enough.

- Strong TypeScript. No "any" to make the build pass.

- Postgres competence: you can read a query plan, write a join, and understand what row-level security does

- Experience with Supabase, or a clear willingness to learn it quickly

- You test your work by running the application and clicking through it, not by reading the diff and declaring it done

- Written English good enough to write a clear bug report and a clear pull request description



NICE TO HAVE

- Supabase specifically (RLS, SECURITY DEFINER functions, migrations)

- Stripe, particularly Connect

- Experience in a scheduling, billing, or booking product



HOW WE WORK

- Small, scoped batches. Each one starts with a read-only audit of the relevant code and ends with behavioral verification before merge.

- Decisions are made before code is written. If a spec is ambiguous, ask first.

- Feature branches and pull requests. No direct commits to main.

- You will work against an isolated test environment. No access to production customer data.

- Daily written standup: what you finished, what you are on, what is blocking you.

- You should be available for at least 2-3 hours of overlap with Central Timezone



Database schema, row-level security policies, and the Stripe Connect integration are mine. You'll build against them and flag anything that looks wrong, but changes there go through me.



TO APPLY

Read this section carefully. Applications that skip it will not be reviewed.



Start your message with the word JETSTREAM on the first line.



Then answer these four questions directly. Short answers are fine.



1. Link to a production Next.js App Router application you built. Tell me which parts were yours.

2. In Postgres, how would you stop one customer's account from reading another customer's rows? Two or three sentences.

3. Describe a bug you found by running the application that you would not have found by reading the code.

4. Your GitHub profile, if you have one.



Do not send a generic cover letter.



Strong candidates will be offered a paid two-week trial at the full rate on a defined scope of work, with an ongoing engagement after that if it goes well.

title: UK B2B Sales Partner | 20% + Recurring Commission
description:
ZA Labs is building a network of independent sales partners who can find genuine business opportunities, build relationships with UK business owners and earn from the revenue they generate.



This is not a fixed-hours VA, call-centre or appointment-setting role.



We're looking for entrepreneurial salespeople who are comfortable working independently — finding the right businesses, reaching decision-makers, understanding their problems and progressing opportunities through to a sale.



You choose how you prospect and organise your time. We'll provide the products, portfolio, sales material, training and founder support when you need it.



What You'll Sell



Our current products include:



ZA Labs Websites



Professional websites for UK small businesses.



• £495 website package

• £995 website package



AnswerMate



Our AI-powered call-answering service for businesses that can't always get to the phone.



• 5-day free trial

• £49/month



As ZA Labs develops new products, there will also be opportunities for our sales network to help take those products to market.



What You'll Earn



This is an independent, commission-based opportunity with no fixed hours or call quotas.



• 20% commission on website sales you originate

• 20% recurring commission on eligible ongoing services you originate

• Uncapped earning potential



Examples:



£495 website sale

You earn £99 (approx. ₱7,700)



£995 website sale

You earn £199 (approx. ₱15,500)



5 × £995 website sales

You earn £995 (approx. ₱77,500)



AnswerMate also gives you the opportunity to build recurring monthly income:



1 active AnswerMate customer

You earn £9.80/month recurring (approx. ₱760)



25 active AnswerMate customers

You earn £245/month recurring (approx. ₱19,100)



50 active AnswerMate customers

You earn £490/month recurring (approx. ₱38,200)



Recurring commission applies while eligible customers remain active and paying.



PHP figures are approximate and will vary with exchange rates.



How We Want You to Sell



We're not interested in simply calling hundreds of random businesses and reading a script.



We want you to look for signals that give us a genuine reason to contact a business.



That might be:



• An outdated or ineffective website

• A strong business with little online presence

• A phone-dependent business where the owner is frequently away from the phone

• Another genuine problem that ZA Labs can solve



Research the business.



Find the decision-maker.



Understand what's happening in their business.



Start a genuine conversation.



Discover whether there is a problem we can solve.



Then introduce the right solution.



Quality of opportunity matters more to us than raw call volume.



What We'll Provide



You won't be left with nothing but a phone and a target.



ZA Labs provides:



• Product and sales training

• Website portfolio and examples

• AnswerMate demonstrations

• Sales material and guidance

• CRM/process support

• Founder support when technical or commercial input can help progress a sale



You'll have the freedom to develop your own approach while still having support when you need it.



Who We're Looking For



This could be a strong fit if you have experience in:



• B2B sales

• Closing sales

• Business development

• Cold calling and outbound prospecting

• SaaS or technology sales

• Website, digital or marketing services

• Selling directly to small-business owners



We're particularly interested in people who can create their own opportunities rather than waiting to be given a list of leads.



It could also suit an experienced independent salesperson who already has business relationships or a network and wants another product range to sell.



UK sales experience is useful, but not essential if you're confident communicating professionally with UK business owners.



Build With Us



This is where the opportunity becomes a little different.



We're not only building a sales network.



We're building a distributed network of people who talk to businesses, discover problems and help us understand what ZA Labs should build next.



A conversation that doesn't result in a website or AnswerMate sale may uncover another problem worth solving.



The idea is simple:



Talk → Find the problem → Validate demand → Build → Test → Sell → Learn → Repeat



Don't just sell what exists. Help us discover what should exist next.



Learn more:



Build With Us — ZA Labs



To Apply



Please answer these three questions:



1. What products or services have you personally sold and closed before?



2. If you started with ZA Labs tomorrow, how would you find and win your first paying UK small-business customer?



3. Why does an independent commission + recurring income model appeal to you?



No need for a long cover letter.



I'm much more interested in how you think, how you sell and whether you can create opportunities independently.



Za

Founder, ZA Labs

title: : Cleaning Company VA — Inbound Sales, Scheduling & Client Coordination (US Hours)
description:
Blank Space is a residential cleaning company in Houston and Dallas, Texas. We are hiring a full-time virtual assistant to run our customer-facing operations so the owner can focus on growth.



Hours are Monday to Friday, 11am to 6pm US Central Time. Please only apply if you can commit to that window with no overlapping clients.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Answer inbound leads from Google Local Services within five minutes. Quote from our pricing calculator and book jobs into GoHighLevel. Send booking confirmations, collect signed terms and payment details, assign cleaners, and send reminders. Send and follow up on invoices. Request and respond to customer reviews. Call past customers to offer recurring service. Coordinate with vendors and freelancers we hire. After the first month, outbound calls to property managers, realtors, and small businesses.



REQUIREMENTS



Excellent spoken and written English with a neutral accent. At least one year supporting a US home-services business, cleaning strongly preferred. Experience with GoHighLevel, Jobber, Housecall Pro, or similar. Located in a major city with reliable internet and a backup power source. Confident closing on the phone and calm with difficult customers. Comfortable using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT as part of your daily workflow. We provide written guidelines and expect you to write in your own words, never paste AI output directly to a customer. Spanish is a strong plus.



PAY



$700 per month base, plus a bonus on every job you book that gets paid, plus 10 percent of the first month's revenue on any commercial or recurring account you source and close yourself. Two-week paid trial. Weekly payment via Wise.



HOW TO APPLY



Reply with all seven of the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.



A two-minute video of yourself speaking in English.

Your city, a screenshot of your internet speed test, and your backup power setup.

The last US home-services company you worked for and the CRM you used.

Your written reply, in your own words, to this customer message: "Hi, I need a move-out clean for a 3 bedroom 2 bath apartment this Saturday, how much?"

Do you speak Spanish? If yes, rate your spoken and written Spanish from 1 to 10 and record thirty seconds of your video in Spanish.

Which AI tools do you use in your work, and one specific example of how you have used one on the job.

Your expected monthly rate.

AnsibleHealth is seeking a skilled and motivated Onboarding Specialist / Medical VA to join our innovative team. As a key member of our patient-centric approach to healthcare delivery, you will play a dual role in guiding new patients through their onboarding journey while managing essential clinical administrative duties. This position combines exceptional customer service with medical documentation expertise, ensuring both smooth patient transitions and efficient clinical operations.



What is AnsibleHealth?

AnsibleHealth unites physicians, nurses, respiratory therapists, and tech experts from Columbia, Johns Hopkins, Google, Amazon, and other top institutions to revolutionize care for chronic disease patients. We combine elite clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver personalized, efficient care at scale. Our team's groundbreaking research, published in leading journals like Nature and PLOS, demonstrates our commitment to innovation. Backed by Bessemer, First Round Capital, AlleyCorp, Breyer Capital, and Inflect Capital, we're a Series A startup partnering with leading healthcare systems nationwide. Our mission is to genuinely improve patient outcomes, not just optimize metrics. If you're passionate about transforming healthcare through technology, join our diverse team in making a real impact.



The Job at a Glance

We are looking for a top-tier Onboarding Specialist / Medical VA to become an integral part of our expanding team. This role is vital in delivering the best care possible to our patients, handling patient communications, and providing essential support to our clinical staff in their mission to offer exceptional care. The ideal candidate will demonstrate exemplary professionalism, excellent English language communication skills, and outstanding organizational abilities with meticulous attention to detail. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute significantly to our patient-centric approach in healthcare delivery.



Responsibilities

• Customize initial discussions based on patient needs, ensuring they understand how the program can address their specific health conditions, providing personalized benefits rather than general services.

• Manage inquiries through multiple communication channels (phone,
, etc.), including voi
 inbox management and message routing, providing prompt and accurate responses.

• Perform comprehensive data entry including clinical survey scores/results, diagnostic tests, remote physiologic monitoring (RPM), and remote therapeutic monitoring (RTM) data streams.

• Schedule and coordinate patient appointments while maintaining communication with patients regarding their care schedule.

• Manage and process inbound and outbound medical records, ensuring proper documentation and organization.

The ideal candidate for this role at AnsibleHealth is a dynamic professional who thrives in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment. They should also possess exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal, coupled with meticulous attention to detail and strong organizational abilities. They should be adept at managing multiple priorities, from patient onboarding to referral management.

Job Details

Full-time: 40 hours a week (with a possible shifting schedule including weekends)

Benefits:  Flexible Paid Time Off

Location: Remote (offshore, and willing to work US hours - EST/EDT)
