title: Business Development & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
About the Role

I am an entrepreneur and business operator building Arli Strategic, a strategy, finance, and operations consulting firm that works with growing businesses, particularly in consumer, beauty, and service-based industries.

In parallel, I am building and evaluating acquisition opportunities in the salon and beauty services industry. Over time, my goal is to build Arli into a broader management services organization that provides centralized strategy, finance, operations, and business support to a portfolio of companies.



I am looking for a highly organized, resourceful, and proactive Business Development & Operations Virtual Assistant to work directly with me.



The initial priority of this role is business development for Arli Strategic. You will help me identify the right people and organizations to build relationships with, research opportunities, manage my business development pipeline, and make sure important follow-ups don't fall through the cracks.



This is not a mass lead-generation, cold-calling, or high-volume outreach position.

I care much more about finding 10 highly relevant opportunities than generating hundreds of generic leads.

As we build strong systems together, the role may expand into broader operations responsibilities across Arli and the businesses we support.



Primary Responsibility: Arli Business Development

Approximately 60–70% of your time will initially focus on business development.

Arli primarily grows through relationships and referrals rather than high-volume cold outreach.

You will help identify and research potential referral and ecosystem partners such as:

Accounting and CPA firms

Law firms

Venture capital and investment firms

Accelerators and incubators

Fractional executives and consultants

Marketing and creative agencies

Business brokers and M&A professionals

Lenders and financial professionals

Founder communities and professional organizations

Other service providers that work with growing companies



Your responsibilities will include:

Identifying high-quality organizations that fit Arli's target market

Finding the appropriate decision-maker or relationship within each organization

Researching why the organization could be relevant to Arli

Finding accurate contact information

Identifying relevant clients, portfolio companies, programs, or partnerships

Looking for mutual connections and potential warm introduction paths

Maintaining organized prospect and relationship lists

Researching people and organizations before meetings

Preparing short meeting briefs

Tracking introductions, opportunities, and follow-ups

Initially, a reasonable target will be approximately 10–15 genuinely qualified and researched prospects per week, depending on the complexity of the research.

Quality is much more important than quantity.

CRM & Relationship Management



You will help me build and maintain an organized business development system.

Responsibilities may include:

Adding and updating contacts

Recording conversations and meeting notes

Tracking outreach

Tracking introductions and referrals

Maintaining next steps and follow-up dates

Flagging overdue follow-ups

Identifying relationships that should be re-engaged

Keeping the pipeline clean and current

My goal is to be able to open the CRM and immediately understand:

Who should I contact? Who am I waiting to hear from? Who needs a follow-up? Where are the strongest opportunities?

Research & Operations Support



Approximately 20–30% of the role may support other projects across Arli and my salon ventures.

Examples could include:

Market and competitor research

Salon industry research

Vendor research and comparisons

Researching potential acquisition opportunities

Organizing acquisition due diligence

Maintaining project trackers

Collecting information or quotes from vendors

Organizing files and documents

Creating research databases

Documenting repeatable processes and SOPs

You do not need salon industry experience.

You do need to be an excellent researcher who can learn new industries quickly.



Marketing & Content Support

Occasionally, you may also assist with:

Formatting and publishing LinkedIn or newsletter content

Maintaining a content calendar

Repurposing existing content

Tracking basic content performance

Researching topics, companies, or examples for future content

You will not be expected to write my thought leadership or strategy content for me.



Who I'm Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you are:

An excellent online researcher

Extremely organized and detail-oriented

Strong in written English

Resourceful and comfortable figuring things out

Able to take a broad request and determine how to execute it

Good at distinguishing a genuinely relevant lead from a generic one

Comfortable working independently

Comfortable using spreadsheets and databases

Able to manage multiple small workstreams

Proactive about identifying missing information and next steps

Interested in learning how businesses are built, operated, and acquired

Experience with tools such as LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Apollo, HubSpot or other CRMs, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Notion, Canva, and AI tools is helpful.

You do not need experience with every tool listed.



What I'm NOT Looking For

This is probably not the right role if your primary experience is:

Mass cold
ing

Sending hundreds of automated LinkedIn messages

Telemarketing

Cold calling all day

Scraping thousands of unqualified leads

Producing large lists without researching whether the contacts are actually relevant

Waiting for detailed instructions before taking every next step

I am looking for someone who can research, organize information, exercise judgment, and eventually take ownership of repeatable processes.



Hours & Compensation

This role will begin at approximately 10 hours per week.

The schedule can be flexible, although some availability overlapping with U.S. Eastern Time will be helpful for communication.

Compensation: $6–$8 USD/hour, depending on experience and capabilities.

I am looking for a long-term working relationship. If the businesses grow and you demonstrate that you can independently own responsibilities, there will be opportunities to increase your hours and potentially grow into a larger operations role.



How to Apply

Please do not send a generic application.

Start your application with the words:

"Arli Growth"

Then answer the following questions:

Tell me briefly about your experience with business development research, lead generation, executive support, or pipeline management.

What tools have you used to research companies, identify decision-makers, and find contact information?

What CRM systems have you used?

Imagine I asked you to find 10 accounting firms that work with emerging beauty, consumer, or startup companies in the United States. Briefly explain how you would approach the research.

Tell me about a time you were given an assignment without detailed instructions. How did you figure out what to do?

What is your desired hourly rate?

How many hours per week are you currently working for other clients or employers?

Please share your resume, LinkedIn profile, or examples of relevant work if available.



Final Application Exercise

Identify one organization that you believe could potentially be a strong referral or ecosystem partner for Arli Strategic.

It can be an accounting firm, law firm, venture capital firm, accelerator, agency, consultant, lender, founder organization, or another type of organization you believe is relevant.

Please provide:

Organization name

Website

Person at the organization you believe I should contact

Their title

Why you selected this organization

2–3 sentences explaining why you believe there could be a relationship opportunity between this organization and Arli Strategic

I am intentionally not providing more detailed instructions for this exercise. I want to see how you approach the research and think about the opportunity.

Applications that do not include "Arli Growth" and the requested referral-partartner example will not be considered.



About the Opportunity

This position is starting at 10 hours per week, but I am building for the long term.

My goal is to build Arli Strategic alongside a portfolio of operating businesses and eventually create a centralized operating platform that supports those companies.

I am looking for someone who enjoys the early stages of building something, likes creating order from ambiguity, and wants the opportunity to take on increasing responsibility as the organization grows.

For the right person, this role has the potential to evolve well beyond traditional virtual assistant work.

Financial and Administrative Tasks

Required Skills and Qualifications

title: React Native / Expo Developer to Take Over and Launch a Finished Fitness App
description:
Start: Monday, September 21, 2026 (or as close to it as you can)



Job overview



Rovexa is an AI fitness app for iOS and Android. The app is built and already on TestFlight. The developer who built it is moving on at the end of September, and I need someone to take it over, get it through App Store and Google Play review, and keep it healthy after launch.



This is not a build-from-scratch role. 



The architecture is d
, the codebase is documented (AGENTS.md, architecture and database docs, feature status, deferred items), and you get a full week of overlap with the outgoing developer. You will be reading someone else's code, following the conventions already in place, and shipping.



What is already working



- Auth with
 plus Apple and Google sign-in, onboarding, user profiles

- Workout tracking with live sessions, a program library, and an exercise library

- Nutrition logging with photo-to-calorie

- Personal journal

- AI coach (four personas) with per-user usage metering. The coach backend is owned by a separate developer; you integrate with it, you do not build it

- HealthKit integration

- Separate dev, staging, and production environments on Supabase and EAS



What you would work on:

- Finishing and testing the RevenueCat subscription flow (sandbox purchases, restore, entitlements)

- Production builds and store submission on both platforms, then fixing whatever review comes back with. I handle screenshots, listing copy, and privacy labels; you handle the technical side

- Bugs from beta testers and the first weeks of real users

- Small features from user feedback

- Keeping the app current with Expo SDK and OS updates over time



How we work:

- Async by default. One written update in Slack at the end of each working day

- One 20-minute call per week

- 4 hours of overlap with Toronto time. The rest of your hours are yours to choose.

- Feature branches and pull requests into main, never direct pushes

- We pay on time and do not micromanage. I do read the code



You would be a strong fit if you:

- Have taken over another developer's React Native codebase before and can say what went right and what went wrong

- Have submitted at least one app to both the App Store and Google Play, and have handled a rejection

- Have shipped React Native / Expo apps in TypeScript. EAS Build and EAS Update experience is a plus

- Know Supabase properly: Postgres, Row Level Security, Storage, Edge Functions, migrations

- Have worked with RevenueCat or in-app subscriptions

- HealthKit or Health Connect experience is a plus

- Have wired up an LLM API (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) is a plus



Train yourself (gym/sports). Optional, but it shows in the work



Why take this role:

A real app, real users within weeks, and a codebase that was built to be handed over. Work with a very experienced founder. when it comes to fitness and marketing.



To apply:



Skip the cover letter. Answer these four, briefly:



- Tell me about a codebase you inherited from another developer. What did you do in the first week, and what went wrong?

- Which apps have you submitted to the App Store and Google Play? Links if public. If you have had a rejection, what was it, and how did you fix it?

- A feature you shipped that used an external API (payments, AI, health data). What was the tricky part?

- Do you train? One line is fine.



Shortlisted candidates get a small paid trial task on the actual codebase. 



I pay for your time on that regardless of the outcome. If it goes well, we talk properly about the role.



Thanks and good luck!

title: B2B Cold Calling Specialist
description:
Lightsail Solutions is a venture-backed, US-based freight forwarding startup making global freight and procurement simpler, more transparent and more efficient. As an early-stage company, our priorities and processes evolve quickly. 



This role is primarily focused on generating qualified sales opportunities through B2B cold calling to American businesses, particularly in e-commerce, construction and machinery. You will identify businesses with international shipping needs, source decision-maker contact information and initiate conversations about our freight forwarding services.



You will be responsible for the full outbound calling workflow, from prospect research, data scraping and list building to cold calling, follow-ups and lead qualification. You should be comfortable working independently, building your own prospect pipeline and using software tools and performance data to improve results.



Responsibilities



* Own the end-to-end execution of B2B cold calling and outbound lead generation targeting the US market

* Identify and research prospective customers, including e-commerce brands, Amazon sellers, construction businesses, equipment dealers and machinery importers

* Use prospecting software, web scraping tools, business directories and data enrichment platforms to build targeted calling lists

* Source and verify company information, decision-maker names, job titles and business phone numbers

* Identify the people responsible for shipping, logistics, procurement or purchasing within target companies

* Make outbound calls during relevant US business hours, navigate gatekeepers and engage decision-makers

* Clearly communicate our freight forwarding services and tailor your approach to each prospect’s industry and shipping needs

* Qualify prospects based on shipping routes, cargo types, shipment volumes, frequency, timelines and current logistics challenges

* Handle objections professionally and identify opportunities to provide quotations or arrange further discussions

* Develop, test and refine call scripts, opening statements, discovery questions and follow-up approaches

* Maintain consistent follow-ups with interested prospects through calls and supporting
s

* Pass qualified opportunities to the relevant sales or operations team with accurate contact information and shipment requirements

* Maintain organised CRM records, including call outcomes, prospect notes, qualification details and next actions

* Track calls made, decision-maker conversations, qualified leads, quotation opportunities and conversions

* Research new tools, data sources and prospecting approaches, and troubleshoot issues independently



Requirements

* Proven experience in B2B cold calling, outbound sales or appointment setting targeting American businesses

* Fluent spoken English, with clear pronunciation and the confidence to hold professional conversations with US clients

* Strong written English for follow-up
s and accurate CRM notes

* Experience independently researching prospects and building calling lists, rather than relying solely on leads provided by an employer

* Hands-on experience with prospecting and contact enrichment tools such as Apollo, ZoomInfo, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or similar platforms

* Experience using web scraping or data extraction tools to collect and organise business information

* Comfortable using diallers, VoIP systems, CRM software and spreadsheets

* Ability to navigate gatekeepers, reach decision-makers, handle objections and maintain productive sales conversations

* Strong discovery and qualification skills, with the ability to distinguish genuine shipping opportunities from general interest

* Able to manage prospecting, daily calling activity and follow-ups independently with minimal supervision

* Results-driven and comfortable working towards agreed activity and qualified-lead targets

* Proactive and resourceful, with the ability to learn new tools and resolve problems independently

* Strong attention to detail when managing prospect data and recording customer requirements

* Available to work during US business hours

* Reliable internet connection, a suitable headset and a quiet working environment

* Available to start immediately or within a short notice period is an advantage



Nice to Have

* Previous sales or lead generation experience in freight forwarding, logistics, supply chain or international shipping

* Experience prospecting e-commerce brands, Amazon sellers, construction companies, equipment dealers or machinery importers

* Previous experience with a B2B outbound sales or lead generation agency serving US clients

* Familiarity with international freight concepts, including air freight, ocean freight, FCL, LCL and Incoterms

* Experience using import/export shipment data to identify potential customers

* Experience with tools such as Clay, Apify, Octoparse, Instant Data Scraper or similar prospecting and automation platforms

* Familiarity with CRM systems such as HubSpot, Pipedrive or Salesforce

* Experience building an outbound calling process from scratch and improving performance through call reviews and data analysis



Compensation

Up to US$1,500 per month, depending on relevant experience and technical knowledge. Commissions payable on qualified leads generated.

title: Video Editor for YouTube Channel (Long Term, Per Video)
description:
I am starting a YouTube channel about philosophy and history, and I need an editor for the long term.



WHAT THE VIDEOS ARE



Narrated videos, 8 to 14 minutes. One voice, one music track, and a series of old oil paintings on screen. No talking head. No stock footage. No motion graphics.



The look is old film. Heavy grain, scratches, dust, warm and faded colour. It should feel like a recording from decades ago.



I will send reference videos to anyone I shortlist.



WHAT I GIVE YOU



Script, voiceover file, music file, and a written brief with exact specs.



WHAT YOU DO



Find public domain paintings, cut them to the voiceover, apply the grain and colour treatment, mix the audio, export.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU



- Good English. My brief is detailed and specific and you need to follow it exactly.

- Premiere, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut.

- Ability to source images yourself from free museum collections.

- Consistency. Every video must match the last one.

- You tell me before you start if something is unclear, instead of guessing.



PAY



$35 per video. Around 30 videos to start, likely more after that. Steady ongoing work if it goes well.



Before that, I am paying $25 for one short test video, about 3 to 4 minutes, so we can both see if it is a fit. Paid on delivery either way.



TO APPLY



Start your message with the word PAINTING so I know you read this.



Then tell me:

1. What software you use

2. What kind of videos you have edited before

3. How long you think one 12 minute video would take you



I am hiring this week.

title: Elite Real Estate ISA / Cold Caller ($10/hr Base + $1,000 Closing Bonuses)
description:
Job Description: We are an elite, US-based real estate investment company specializing in foreclosure relief, mortgage rescue, and sheriff sales. We are looking for an exceptional, highly motivated Inside Sales Agent (ISA) / Cold Caller to join our team. This role starts part-time as we test our top candidates, with the immediate intent to scale hours and lead volume for the right performer. 



This is a highly focused, relationship-driven campaign targeting a meticulously scrubbed list of active foreclosure prospects in Pennsylvania (717 Area Code). Every single lead has been hand-selected based on extreme motivation criteria, including specific age brackets (many over the age of 50) and a minimum of home equity. Because every single successful acquisition requires massive capital deployment and extreme precision, we are looking for top-tier talent and are paying premium rates to secure the absolute best. 



💰 Compensation & Elite Perks:

• Base Salary: $10.00 per hour (Premium rate for elite callers). 

• Payout Frequency: Paid every single Sunday with zero delays. 

• The Big Win Bonus: +$1,000.00 cash bonus for every deal that successfully closes from your leads. 

• Appointment Bonus: +$10.00 for every qualified appointment you set. 

• Monthly Performance Bonus: +$100.00 monthly bonus for hitting core consistency metrics. 

• Holiday Perks: Christmas Bonus included for long-term dedicated team members. 



💼 Core Responsibilities & The Split-Shift Schedule: You will manually call highly targeted foreclosure leads using our Quo digital web system and a shared "Daily Dials" Google Sheet. Because we are targeting Pennsylvania homeowners, you must be comfortable working a split schedule during peak US Eastern Standard Time (EST) windows. 



You will execute dials strictly during one or both of these two blocks:

• The Mid-Morning Block: 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM EST (This is 10:00 PM – 12:00 AM PHT)

• The Late Afternoon Block: 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM EST (This is 4:00 AM – 6:00 AM PHT)



During these calls, you will:

• Engage with mature homeowners experiencing real estate distress with extreme empathy, patience, and absolute professionalism. 

• Explain how our company can help them protect their massive home equity before a sheriff sale auction takes place. 

• Accurately log call results, notes, and appointment details directly back into our shared system. 

• Send quick, professional text message follow-ups via Quo to homeowners who do not answer the live call. 



🛠️ Strict Technical & Experience Requirements:

• Flawless, accent-neutral English with outstanding verbal and written communication skills. 

• Minimum 1–2 years of experience cold-calling in real estate (Wholesaling, REI, ISA, or Appointment Setting). 

• Hardwired Connection: You must plug your computer directly into your internet router with an Ethernet cable to eliminate VoIP jitter. 

• Low Latency Setup: You must have a ping to the US under 150ms to prevent noticeable conversation delays. 

• Audio Equipment: You must operate in a quiet home office using a dedicated noise-canceling USB headset. 

• Ability to work independently, stay organized on Excel/Google Sheets, and manage data cleanly. 

• A highly motivated, competitive attitude—you love setting appointments and chasing large closing commissions. 



📩 How to Apply (Mandatory Screen Test):

To be considered for an interview, you must do the following:

• Reply to this post with your updated resume and a screenshot of your Speedtest.net results verifying a ping to the US under 150ms. 

• Include a link to a 1-minute audio recording (using Vocaroo or Loom). 

• In the recording, read the exact script provided below. We are looking for a tone that is slow, warm, professional, and deeply empathetic. 

• Applications without an audio recording link and a verified speed test screenshot will be automatically declined. 



🎙️ Voice Audition Script: "Hi [Homeowner's First Name]... good morning. My name is [Your Name], and I know this call is completely out of the blue, so I promise to be incredibly brief. I’m calling on behalf of a local real estate group here in Pennsylvania. We were looking through the county public records regarding upcoming sheriff sales, and your property on [Street Name] came up. I was just calling to see if you have a solid plan in place to pause or stop that auction, or if you are looking for some outside help to protect the equity you built up in the home?"

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



If you have never worked a graveyard shift before, think carefully before applying. We will ask you specifically how you plan to structure your sleep, and how you'll make the schedule work alongside your family or partner. "I'll figure it out" is not an answer that gets you hired. This shift is sustainable for people who plan for it and difficult for people who don't.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

HIRING PROCESS

title: QA tester for a new mobile web app — one-off project
description:
We have built a social app for iPhone and Android. It runs in the browser, not as an app you install. It is nearly ready for real users and needs a careful pass before launch.



We are looking for one person to test it once, thoroughly, and write up what they find. This is a single project, not ongoing work.



One thing to know before applying: it is a dating and social app for gay men.



The Job:



You will be given a detailed guide — around fourteen sections — with exact steps. Sign in, post, reply, join a private room, organise a meet-up, use the map, look at events. For each step you record what happened.



Two things matter more than the rest.



First, the browser console. You keep it open the entire time and record every error, even when the screen looks completely normal. We have had bugs where a screen looked perfect and something was broken underneath. That is the single most valuable thing you can find.



Second, and this is why we are looking for someone with customer support experience: at the end of each section we want you to tell us what a real user would have been confused by. Not whether it worked — whether it made sense. 



What you need



An iPhone and an Android phone, or access to both. Tell us which you have.

A desktop or laptop browser as well.

Comfort with opening and reading a browser console. We can show you how if you have not done it, but you should be comfortable being shown.

Clear written English. Your report is the deliverable.

Able to follow a long, precise document without skipping.



Not required: coding, automated testing tools, formal QA certification.



What we will give you



The testing guide, step by step

Test accounts, already set up

All the content you need to post — copy and paste, do not write your own

All the photographs you need. Never upload your own photos, from any source

A report form to fill in



How to apply



Please tell us:



Which phones you have, and their operating system versions.

Whether you have opened a browser console before. "No" is a fine answer.

One thing you have found in a product that technically worked but confused users — from support or from testing, either is fine.

title: Ecommerce Operations Manager – Manage Video Editing Team & Support ($1,000/month)
description:
We're a European ecommerce company running several consumer brands on Shopify. We sell with Meta ads, and our creative output is the engine of the business — so we need someone reliable running the day-to-day of that engine.



Right now we have 4 video editors and 1 customer support agent. Over the next 1–2 months we're growing the editing team to 8. We need an Operations Manager to take over the daily running of that team so the founders can focus on growth.



This is not a role where you'll be doing the editing yourself. You'll be managing the people who do.



We are hiring for the long term. We're not looking for someone to fill a gap for a few months. We want one person who takes ownership of this, gets better at it over years, and grows as the company grows. If you're looking for something short-term or to run alongside other clients, please don't apply.



What you'll be doing



Assigning daily work to our video editors and keeping track of what's due

Reviewing the ads they produce and approving or rejecting them

Quality-checking the work: do the captions match the voiceover, is the editing clean, is the brief followed, does it actually look good enough to run

Giving editors clear, specific feedback on what to fix and following up that it got fixed

Answering editors' questions as they come up so nobody is sitting blocked waiting on you

Supporting our customer support agent — she works independently, but needs a second opinion on refund decisions and help with difficult or unusual customer situations

General operational support across our Shopify stores and Meta ad accounts

Flagging problems to us early instead of letting them sit



What we're looking for



Real experience managing a remote team. This is the most important requirement. You've been responsible for other people's output before, not just your own.

Fluent, natural written and spoken English. You'll be writing feedback and instructions daily and speaking with us directly — it needs to be understood the first time.

Drive. We need someone who chases things down rather than waiting to be asked. If an editor goes quiet, you notice. If the same mistake happens twice, you fix the process.

Strong eye for creative quality. You can watch a short-form ad and say why it's weak or strong — hook, pacing, captions, edit quality.

Comfortable giving direct feedback without being harsh. Our editors are good people and we want them to stay.

Ecommerce or digital marketing experience (preferred, not essential)



What we offer



$1,000 USD/month to start, paid on time, every month

Raises for people who earn them. We review pay and we reward results — if you make this team better, you'll be paid more for it. This isn't a "maybe someday" promise; it's how we've grown the team we already have.

Real responsibility. You'll own the creative output of the business, not just push tasks around.

Room to grow. The team is expanding and so is the scope of this role. The person who does this well ends up running a lot more than the editing team.

A company that's actually growing. We're not a lifestyle business coasting along.



Requirements



❌ No agencies — individual applicants only

❌ No other full-time job or ongoing client work. This role requires you to be reachable through the day.

Reliable internet and a computer capable of smooth video playback



Hours — please read carefully



This is 4 hours of actual work per day, 7 days a week, but the hours are split, not a single block.



You might do 2 hours in the morning and 2 hours in the evening. The important part is that you're reachable through the day — if an editor has a question or something needs answering, we need you to pick it up rather than it sitting for eight hours.



If you want a fixed 4-hour block and then to be fully offline, this role isn't the right fit. If you're comfortable checking in through the day around your own schedule, it works well.



You choose the specific hours and work in your own timezone that matches the team.



Start date: ASAP



How to apply



Please follow all three steps. Applications that skip a step won't be read.



1. Put "EDITOR OPS" as the first two words of your subject line.



2. Send us your LinkedIn profile (or a CV / portfolio link if you don't have one), plus a quick list of where you've managed people — company name, your role, dates, and how many people reported to you. A few lines is fine.



3. Answer these three questions. Short answers are fine — a few sentences each.



What's the biggest team you've managed, and what were they producing?

How do you tell someone their work isn't good enough? Describe how you'd actually word it.

What makes a short-form video ad good? In your own words.



Also tell us when you'd be online across the day and whether you have any other work commitments.



What happens next: we'll reply to shortlisted applicants within a few days for a short interview. There's a paid trial period before we commit long-term.

What You’ll Be Doing



Brand Outreach & Lead Generation

• Find relevant influencer marketing, partnerships, PR and marketing contacts

• Build qualified brand lead lists

• Personalize and prepare outreach using my existing pitch templates

Inbox & Brand Communication



• Help organize incoming brand
s and collaboration requests

UGC Business Operations

• Track campaign deadlines, deliverables, invoices and payments

• Organize briefs, contracts and campaign information

• Keep my weekly priorities organized

• Help make sure opportunities and deadlines don’t fall through the cracks



What I’m Looking For



You might be a great fit if you:



• Have excellent written English

• Are extremely organized and detail-oriented

• Are comfortable researching brands and finding decision-maker contact information

• Can follow systems while also using good judgment

• Learn someone’s communication style quickly

• Are proactive instead of waiting to be told every next step

• Are comfortable working independently

• Understand social media and the creator/influencer industry

• Are interested in growing with a small creator-led business long-term



Bonus: Previous experience with UGC creators, influencers, influencer marketing, sales outreach, lead generation,
 outreach or creator agencies.



Hours



Starting at approximately 10–15 hours per week, with the opportunity to increase hours and responsibilities as the business grows.



I care much more about consistency, quality of work and results than being online for a specific number of hours each day.



You’ll Be Given



You will NOT be expected to figure everything out from scratch.



I’ll provide:



• Brand and creator business guidelines

• Outreach SOPs

• Pitch templates by industry

• Follow-up sequences

• Communication/voice guide

• Brand qualification criteria

• CRM and tracking systems

• Pricing and escalation guidelines

• Examples of previous brand conversations

• Weekly priorities and KPIs



My goal is to build systems that allow you to become increasingly independent over time.



Success in This Role Looks Like



You aren’t just completing tasks. You’re helping create a consistent pipeline of brand opportunities.



We’ll track things like:



• Qualified brands researched

• Personalized pitches sent

• Follow-ups completed

• Brand response rate

• Qualified opportunities generated

• Outreach consistency

• CRM accuracy

• Revenue generated from outbound opportunities



To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Any experience you have with creators, UGC, influencer marketing, lead generation or
 outreach.

3. The tools you’re comfortable using.

5. Your weekly availability.

6. Your internet speed and typical working hours/time zone.



And please answer this question:



Imagine I tell you I want to work with a premium skincare brand. Walk me through exactly how you would research the company, identify the right person to contact and prepare the brand for outreach.



Please start your application with the word “CHLOE” so I know you’ve read the full listing.



I’m looking for someone I can build a long-term working relationship with as my creator business grows. If you’re proactive, organized, resourceful and excited about helping build systems from the early stages, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Appointment Setter - Cold Calling for US B2B Cleaning Company
description:
Anvil Facility Services is a commercial cleaning company based in New York City. Our accounts are offices, medical and dental practices, high-end retail stores, and similar facilities. We are filling one seat: an appointment setter who calls businesses and puts walkthroughs on the owner's calendar.



The entire job is the phone. Expect over 200 dials a day. Skip this posting if calling strangers is not something you want to do all night.



THE WORK

You dial from lists we hand you. Building lists is not your job.

Get past the front desk to whoever makes the cleaning decision.

Work our script. The offer is a in-person walkthrough and a free quote.

Put the appointment on the owner's calendar before the call ends.

Confirmation
 inside 10 minutes, reminder
 the day before, text the morning of. Show rate is part of the job, not extra credit.

Log every call in the dialer. It pushes to the CRM on its own.

Build the next day's callback list during your midday break.

Close each shift with a short report of your numbers.



HOURS

Monday through Friday, 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila time. That matches business hours on the US East Coast. The hours are fixed. Do not apply if permanent night work will not work for you long term.



The shift runs in blocks:

9:00 PM to 11:30 PM Manila. Dialing, callbacks before new names.

11:30 PM to 12:30 AM. Dialing.

12:30 AM to 1:30 AM. Break, plus confirmation
s, texts, and tomorrow's callback list.

1:30 AM to 4:30 AM. Dialing.

4:30 AM to 5:00 AM. Shift report.



PAY

Base is $600 a month, paid on two cycles.



On top of that, $20 for every walkthrough that actually happens. It counts when the owner arrives and the meeting takes place. Cancellations and no-shows pay nothing, which is the reason the confirmations and texts matter.



Hit 20 held walkthroughs in a month and you are at $1,000. Hit 30 and you are at $1,200. Nothing is capped.



WHAT WE COVER

Power dialer, phone numbers, lead lists, CRM access, the script, and training. None of it comes out of your pocket.



REQUIREMENTS

- Spoken English clear enough that a US receptionist never asks you to repeat yourself.

- Wired internet, 10 Mbps upload or better. Mobile data does not qualify.

- USB headset with a boom mic. Earbuds are not acceptable.

- A quiet room. No roosters, no street noise, no family audible behind you.

- A real track record cold calling US businesses. Name the company and how long you were there.



HELPFUL (not required)

HubSpot experience. Power dialer experience. B2B appointment setting for a service company.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Answer these in your message:

- Your experience with outbound cold calling

- Any experience with outbound cold calling for commercial cleaning specifically or B2B service businesses

2. Put Anvil in your subject line.

3. Attach an audio file of yourself reading these two lines:

"Hi, this is [your name] calling from Anvil Facility Services. Who handles the cleaning for your office?"

"We are doing free 20-minute walkthroughs in the neighborhood this week. Would Tuesday morning or Thursday afternoon work better?"

title: Frontend Developer / Site Cloner (custom + Railway)
description:
About the role



We run a portfolio of ecommerce brands. No hosted store platforms, no WordPress, no page builders — we build our own custom sites, from code, and we deploy them ourselves on Railway. We launch new ones constantly.



Your job: take a reference site we give you and rebuild it as a custom, self-hosted site — same layout, same sections, same behavior, same mobile rendering — under the new brand, deployed live on Railway, then wired to our external checkout and tracking.



You are not designing anything. You reproduce a layout exactly, in clean code, fast, and ship it live. Copy, images, product data and brand kit all come from us.



If you can take a reference site in the morning and hand back a live, mobile-perfect, tracking-verified URL by the end of the day, you will never run out of work with us.



The deadline: this is the core of the job



Every site ships live within 24 to 48 hours of kickoff. Not "usually". Every time.



24h for a site built from our existing base template (most of the work)

48h for a site that needs new sections or something we haven't built before



Kickoff means the moment we hand you the complete package: reference site, brand kit, copy, images, product data, checkout parameters, tracking IDs. The clock starts there. If something is missing from that package, you tell us within the first hour — not at hour 20.



How this is possible: you are not designing, not writing copy, not sourcing images. You reproduce a layout from a reference, on a codebase we already built, with assets we already prepared. The whole system is built for speed, and your job is to keep it that way.



What we expect when a deadline is at risk: a message from you as soon as you see it coming, with what's blocking and what you need. A late site we knew about 12 hours in advance is a problem we can manage. A late site we discover at the deadline is not.



If you need a week to build a landing page, this role is not for you and you'll be miserable here. Please don't apply.



What you will do



Build



Reproduce a reference site's front-end in clean custom code: structure, sections, spacing, typography, animations, responsive behavior

Stack: HTML + Tailwind CSS + JavaScript, or Next.js / Astro / React depending on the project

No page builders, no WordPress, no drag-and-drop. You write the code.

Build it templated and reusable — we relaunch the same base under new brands, so brand name, colors, fonts, logo, domain, product data and checkout URLs live in one config file or env vars, never hardcoded across 40 files



Deploy



Railway: repo setup, Dockerfile or build config, environment variables, custom domain, SSL, redirects

Cloudflare DNS: records, SSL mode, caching, page rules

Fix your own deployment problems — build failures, SSL errors, env issues — without us holding your hand

* Practical experience using Meta Ads Manager for
 and Instagram advertising.

* Strong working knowledge of ChatGPT, Claude, and AI-powered creative tools.

* Experience using AI image- and video-generation or editing tools such as Higgsfield and Nano Banana.

* Experience building, managing, or updating Shopify stores.

* Familiarity or practical exposure to Amazon and TikTok.

* Strong organization, attention to detail, time management, and follow-through.

title: Fitness app Virtual Assistant - Member Support & Program Management
description:
About Ruff Academy



Ruff Academy is an online bodybuilding and physique-development platform created by IFBB professional bodybuilder Terrence Ruffin. We provide training programs, posing education, physique-development resources, and a community for people who want to improve.



We are looking for a reliable and highly organized virtual assistant to manage daily Academy operations and provide excellent support to our members.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Upload training programs, videos, documents, and educational resources

- Organize programs so members can easily find and understand everything

- Test uploaded programs, videos, links, and downloads before publishing

- Welcome new members and confirm they can access their purchases

- Respond to routine support questions involving logins, payments, navigation, program access, and technical issues

- Monitor member questions and community activity throughout the day

- Answer questions using approved information and previous responses

- Collect questions requiring Terrence's expertise into one organized daily report

- Turn Terrence's answers into clear responses and send them to members promptly

- Track unresolved requests until every member receives a response

- Maintain an FAQ using answers approved by Terrence

- Moderate the community and remove spam or inappropriate content

- Collect member feedback, testimonials, and transformation stories with permission

- Identify recurring questions and suggest helpful programs, videos, or resources

- Flag cancellations, refund requests, payment problems, and unhappy members immediately

- Maintain a calendar of upcoming programs and Academy content



WEEKLY REPORT



Provide a short weekly report covering new members, cancellations, support requests, unresolved problems, frequently asked questions, content uploaded, member feedback, and recommended improvements.



IMPORTANT BOUNDARIES



This is an operations and member-support position, not a coaching position. You must not independently give training, nutrition, supplement, injury, or contest-preparation advice; create or modify programs; approve refunds or special pricing; make promises without approval; or speak publicly on behalf of Terrence or Ruff Academy. Questions without an approved answer must be escalated to Terrence.



REQUIREMENTS



- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong organization and attention to detail

- Friendly, professional communication

- Reliable internet and consistent daily availability

- Ability to follow instructions without changing important information

- Comfortable learning HubFit and other online tools

- Ability to recognize when a question should be escalated

- Basic familiarity with bodybuilding and fitness terminology

- Responsible with private member information



Experience with customer support, virtual assistance, online coaching platforms, membership communities, or digital courses is preferred.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



- Part-time: 10 hours per week

- $300 USD per month

- Flexible schedule, but member messages must be checked at least twice each workday

- Potential for additional hours and increased compensation as Ruff Academy grows



HOW TO APPLY



Please provide:

1. A short introduction

2. Your relevant experience

3. Your familiarity with fitness or bodybuilding

4. Your availability and time zone

5. The platforms and software you have used

6. A link to a 60-second video introducing yourself

7. Your response to this scenario:



A member says: "I purchased a training program, but I cannot find Week 3. I already sent a message and haven't heard back."



Write the exact response you would send and briefly explain the steps you would take to resolve the problem.



Begin your application subject line with RUFF ACADEMY so we know you read the entire posting.

title: AI & Automation Specialist (Contract, Remote)
description:
We are a small U.S.-based law firm looking for a hands-on AI & Automation Specialist to help us build AI tools, automations, and internal applications that make our practice run better.



This is a flexible, project-based contractor role with strong potential for ongoing work. You'll work directly with the managing attorney, who has broad AI and automation experience, and have real ownership of what you build. We bring the problems and you figure out how to solve them.



About the work:



We're a legal practice, so the work comes with real constraints. You'll be handling confidential client information, and the tools you build need to be secure, reliable, and easy for our legal staff to review. We want someone who can remove the repetitive work around legal judgment, not replace it.



We run OpenClaw as our core AI agent platform, integrated with our cloud-based firm applications. Those include Clio Grow for intake, Clio Manage for matter management, Allo for our phone system, Outlook for
, and several internal applications we built with Lovable that still need further development and integration. Much of this role involves extending that setup by building new OpenClaw skills and integrations, finishing and connecting the Lovable apps, hardening what already exists, and layering AI on top of the systems we already use.



A likely first project would be improving and streamlining our Allo integration, so that calls, transcripts, and AI call summaries flow cleanly into Clio and the rest of our workflow with less manual handling.



What you may work on:



Building, maintaining, and extending our OpenClaw agent with new skills, integrations, and workflows

Continuing development on our existing Lovable apps and building new internal apps with Lovable and Supabase

Creating AI agents and AI-powered workflows for intake, document drafting, deadline tracking, and client communication

Building automations with n8n, Zapier, or similar tools

Connecting Clio, Allo, Outlook, and our internal apps through APIs and webhooks

Using Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, and other AI tools to build and prototype quickly

Working with GitHub and cloud-hosted applications

Researching and testing new AI tools and telling us honestly which ones are worth it

Troubleshooting and improving existing automations



Who we're looking for:



You don't need to be a senior software engineer. We want someone who understands technology, is comfortable using AI to help build solutions, learns quickly, and can take a loosely defined idea and turn it into something that works.



Because this is legal work, we also need someone who takes confidentiality seriously, documents what they build, and is careful about where data goes.



Experience with some of the following is helpful. OpenClaw or similar self-hosted agent frameworks, Lovable, Supabase, Claude/Claude Code, ChatGPT, n8n, Zapier, APIs, GitHub, DigitalOcean, Clio, Allo, or Microsoft 365.



Confidentiality and security:



This role involves access to confidential and privileged client information, and our OpenClaw agent holds credentials to firm systems. A signed NDA is required, along with adherence to our data security and confidentiality policies. All AI tools, models, and third-party services used with client data must be approved in advance, and any new agent capabilities that can take actions in firm systems will be reviewed before deployment.



Compensation and logistics:



Independent contractor, part-time, paid in USD

Fully remote, with some regular availability during U.S. Central Time business hours for check-ins and troubleshooting

Strong written and spoken English, since you'll be working directly with the managing attorney and documenting what you build

Starts with a paid trial project



To apply:



Please send the following.



A short introduction and a summary of your technical and AI experience

Examples of apps, automations, AI agents, or other projects you've built. Personal projects are welcome.

The AI and automation tools you use regularly

Your compensation expectations

Your general availability



Please also answer this question. If a small law firm told you, "We want to use AI and automation throughout our practice, but we don't always know what's possible," what are the first three things you would investigate or build, and why?



We care more about curiosity, problem-solving ability, and what you can actually build than degrees or job titles.

title: Property Management Virtual Assistant – Organization & Administrative Support
description:
I am a Los Angeles-based property manager seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help organize and streamline the administrative operations for a portfolio of four apartment buildings.



The initial priority of this position will be getting all property information, records, accounts, schedules, tenant documentation, vendors, and operating procedures properly organized into a clear and easy-to-maintain system.



I currently use Yardi for property management and tenant records. Yardi will remain the primary system for tenant-specific documentation, while other property operations and administrative information will be organized into appropriate spreadsheets, files, and systems.



Responsibilities will include:



* Creating a master information sheet/dashboard for each property

* Organizing utility and service account information, including account numbers and service details

* Organizing property information such as trash/recycling schedules, landscaping schedules, building services, parking information, and other property-specific details

* Organizing building access and operating information, including intercom instructions, camera/security systems, access information, and other building procedures

* Creating recurring maintenance schedules for each property, including AC/HVAC filter changes, inspections, preventative maintenance, and other recurring building needs

* Creating daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual property-management schedules and checklists

* Creating and maintaining a complete vendor directory organized by trade/service and property

* Auditing and organizing current tenant records within Yardi

* Uploading and properly labeling leases, applications, addenda, IDs/supporting documents, move-in documentation, notices, and other appropriate tenant records in Yardi

* Reviewing tenant files and identifying missing or incomplete documentation

* Assisting with tenant rosters and rent-roll information

* Organizing Airbnb/short-term rental operational information, including Wi-Fi information, access instructions, property instructions, and other important details

* Organizing existing Google Drive/property-management files into a logical and consistent structure

* Creating spreadsheets, trackers, templates, checklists, and organizational systems as needed

* Identifying missing, incomplete, or outdated property information and bringing it to my attention

* Maintaining and updating these systems after the initial organization is completed

* Providing additional property-management administrative support as needed



I am looking for someone who can do more than basic data entry. The ideal candidate should be able to take information from multiple sources, determine how it should be organized, identify missing information, and help create efficient systems that are easy to maintain going forward.



Previous experience working with a U.S.-based property management or real estate company is strongly preferred.



The ideal candidate should have:



* Strong Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel skills

* Strong Google Drive and document-management skills

* Experience organizing property-management or real-estate records

* Experience working with property-management software; Yardi experience is a plus

* Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills

* Strong written English and communication skills

* The ability to work independently and ask questions when information is unclear

* An understanding of confidentiality when handling tenant, property, and business information

* Reliability and an interest in establishing a long-term working relationship



This is a part-time position. Initially, there will be more hours while we organize and build the systems for all four properties. Once the initial organization is completed, the workload will decrease and transition into ongoing part
-needed administrative support.



Please begin your application with the words “Property Management VA” so I know you have read the entire job description.

title: Marketing Specialist (Ninja)
description:
ORGANIC GROWTH & CONTENT MARKETER



Philippines · Remote · Full-time



Naaxtech is a technology execution team building production software, AI systems, and marketing infrastructure for international clients. Our work spans women-led products, LGBTQ+ communities, and global audiences.



We’re looking for a hands-on marketer who can turn audience insight into sharp copy, creative content, and measurable organic growth without needing an advertising budget to produce results.



Open to fresh graduates and junior applicants.



This is a broad role, but we’re not hunting for a mythical marketing unicorn who has mastered every platform, tool, and discipline.



Proven copywriting skills and excellent English are essential. Beyond that, we’re looking for someone curious, resourceful, and eager to grow—someone who learns quickly, takes ownership, and isn’t afraid to explore unfamiliar territory.



You don’t need to know everything on day one.



You do need the drive to keep learning and produce quality work you’re proud of.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



* Manage marketing across multiple client accounts while maintaining quality, accuracy, and deadlines.

* Write and proofread world-facing copy for high-profile brands, including websites, landing pages,
s, social content, ads, and CTAs.

* Conduct Voice of Customer research and develop useful buyer personas before creating campaigns.

* Plan, create, publish, and analyse content across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other applicable channels.

* Develop resourceful organic campaigns that earn attention without relying on paid advertising.

* Create impactful, polished assets using tools such as Canva, CapCut, and AI image or video generators.

* Communicate clearly with clients and our team, manage competing priorities, and take ownership from brief to delivery.



WHAT YOU MUST BRING



* Proven copywriting skills, supported by a portfolio of published work.

* A strong understanding of copywriting fundamentals, including headlines, CTAs, audience awareness, and conversion-focused messaging.

* A clear understanding of the different roles played by a homepage, landing page,
, advertisement, and social post.

* Excellent written and spoken English, with exceptional proofreading skills and attention to detail.

* Experience managing multiple clients, projects, and deadlines without allowing standards to slip.

* Strong organic marketing instincts, creativity, and the resourcefulness to produce results with limited or no budget.

* The ability to adapt your writing to different audiences and brand voices without relying on clichés or stereotypes.

* Self-direction, sound judgement, and the confidence to question a brief when it is unlikely to achieve the intended result.

* Willingness to learn, ask questions when something is unclear, and admit to errors.



EVEN BETTER IF YOU HAVE



* Hands-on experience with Canva, CapCut, or other design and video-editing tools.

* Experience generating high-quality images and videos using AI tools.

* Working knowledge of CRM, marketing automation, or scheduling platforms.

* Strong prompt-writing skills and a genuine interest in using AI intelligently, rather than simply producing more generic content at speed.

* Demonstrated experience with
 marketing, funnel strategy, and conversion-focused campaigns.

* The ability to define meaningful campaign objectives, interpret performance data, and explain what should happen next.

* A practical understanding of SEO, conversion optimisation, and customer journeys.



A STRONG CANDIDATE UNDERSTANDS



* The difference between marketing with a community and marketing at one.

* The psychology behind growing and maintaining a healthy online community.

* Why Voice of Customer research and buyer personas matter.

* Why authenticity often outperforms polished content on organic social.

* How to write respectfully for audiences whose experiences may differ from their own.

* That AI can accelerate the work, but taste, judgement, and originality still determine its quality.



THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE RIGHT FOR YOU IF



* You depend on paid advertising to make every campaign work.

* You treat proofreading as someone else’s responsibility.

* You struggle to manage several clients or deliver consistently on time.

* You become defensive when your work is questioned or corrected.

* Your understanding of women-led or LGBTQ+ audiences begins and ends with Pride Month.

* You believe engagement matters more than the people behind the numbers.

* Stepping outside your job description to help the team frustrates you.



HOW TO APPLY



Send us your portfolio, including 2–3 links to examples of your copywriting and organic marketing work.



Applications without relevant copywriting samples will not be considered.



Please also send either:



* A written response of up to 500 words, or

* A Loom video of up to three minutes



Answer the following:



1. What is something unique about you?

2. What does a brand you admire get right that most brands get wrong?

3. Which piece of work in your portfolio are you most proud of, and why?

4. What skills are you missing from this job posting, and how would you develop them?

5. What other skills do you bring to the table that we should know about?



Please send everything to:







CC:







No cinematic editing. No elaborate deck. No acting required.



We’re hiring a marketer. You don’t have to be polished, and it’s okay if you’re not comfortable in front of the camera.



📍 Remote — Philippines-based preferred

You will play a key role in supporting our credential evaluation team by conducting in-depth research on foreign education systems, academic policies, institutional recognition, grading practices, and program structures.

Qualifications

Why Join Us?

description:

Remote | E-Commerce

 across our beauty brand and other consumer products. You’ll help customers with everything from order and shipping questions to returns, refunds, product concerns, and the occasional situation that requires a little extra digging.

title: Senior Funnel Builder
description:
Senior Funnel Builder

Remote | USD $5–$8/hour



We’re looking for a Senior Funnel Builder who thinks beyond the build.



Yes, you should know how to build and maintain high-performing funnels. But more importantly, you should understand why a funnel converts, what makes a product win, and how to turn those insights into new opportunities.



You’ll work closely with our Product Manager and Creative Lead to build, optimize, and continuously improve our funnel portfolio. If you enjoy looking at data, spotting opportunities, testing ideas, and turning one successful concept into several strong variations, we’d love to hear from you.



What You’ll Do



Build, maintain, and optimize funnels using Funnelish.

Conduct regular funnel and quality checks to make sure everything works smoothly.

Review funnels from both a technical and conversion-focused perspective.

Analyze winning products and funnels to understand what is driving their performance.

Create meaningful variations of winning funnels, products, and offers without losing what made the original successful.

Test new angles, offers, hooks, messaging, positioning, and funnel structures.

Write and refine conversion-focused copy, including headlines, hooks, CTAs, offers, upsells, and product messaging.

Use testing and performance insights to continuously improve conversion rates.

Help establish and maintain strong funnel-building and optimization practices across the team.



What We’re Looking For

- 2+ years of experience building and optimizing sales funnels.

- Strong hands-on experience with Funnelish, or the ability to become highly proficient with it quickly.

- Strong conversion-focused copywriting skills.

- A solid understanding of funnel structure, customer journeys, offers, and conversion principles.

- Experience with winner optimization, A/B testing, and developing variations from successful funnels or products.

- The ability to think beyond simply changing colors, layouts, or buttons—you should be able to develop new angles, offers, hooks, and messaging based on what the data is telling you.

- A strong eye for design, usability, and detail.
